7. **THE FAR BENCH WAS OCCUPIED ON THREE OF THE TEN DAYS, BEING THE TWENTY-SEVENTH AND THIRTIETH OF APRIL AND THE THIRD OF MAY, and was not occupied at any hour on the other seven; the holder of that writ did not go over to him on any of the ten, and was in that harbor on all ten and up no coast road on any of them.**

### 2. The new canon of this batch

1. **THE WORD *QUIETENING* IS NAMED ONCE, IN CHAPTER 281, IN A CHARACTER'S MOUTH, BY MARA VENN, IN A SHED, AND IT IS NAMED NOWHERE ELSE IN THE TEN CHAPTERS AND NOWHERE EARLIER IN VOLUME 06.** It is a name for a practice and not for a person, a place, an office or a title, and the practice is that a person who holds a reading of a made thing which cannot be true at the same time as another person's reading of it is asked in writing, in a room with a second person in it, to withdraw the reading and not to change it, and that she filled in the forms and asked the questions for nine years. **She said out loud on the same day that nobody she ever asked said who wanted it, not one, in nine years, and that she stopped asking in about the fifth year — and that is the volume's motive not being stated, said by the person who had the best place to state it and declining to state it.** **IT IS NOT A CHAPTER HEADING AND IT IS NOT IN ANY COLUMN OF THAT YARD'S OWN BOOK, and the fourth column takes it in its own words as a thing it is not.**
2. **THE READ IS NOT FOUND, IT IS BOUGHT, AND THE ARITHMETIC IS PAID IN FULL ON THE PAGE, IN A COPYIST'S MOUTH AND IN THE YARD'S OWN SECOND COLUMN.** **A SET IS A PRESSURE HOUSE'S SET ON A BOOK AND GOES WHERE THE BOOK SENDS IT; THERE IS NO BOOK ON THAT COAST THAT SENDS IT FOUR HUNDRED MILES WEST; THERE IS NO YARD ON THAT COAST THAT RENTS ONE; AND THERE IS NOTHING IN THIS COUNTRY A MAN CAN HIRE THAT WILL GO AND STAND IN A ROOM SEVENTY FATHOMS DOWN AND HOLD A LAMP IN IT.** Said out loud in that shed on the Monday the twenty-sixth by the ship's hand, with the standing that *we cannot go* and *we will not go* are different words and only the first of them is true. **THIS PARTY DOES NOT GO AND THE READ IS BROUGHT TO IT, AND THE CHANNEL IS A COPYIST'S COUNTER OFF THE FISH MARKET, WHERE A SHEET IS A PENNY AND FORTY SHEETS A SHILLING AND THE ONLY THING IN THIS COUNTRY THAT WILL COPY ANYTHING WITHOUT ASKING WHAT IT IS FOR.**
3. **THE SHEET EXISTS, WAS NEVER ASKED FOR, AND CAME TO THE YARD IN A SINGLE OCCASION BY A SINGLE QUESTION.** **PERNEL SAYE, FIFTY-EIGHT, A COPYIST OF THIS HARBOR WHO HAS KEPT THAT COUNTER FOR THIRTY-ONE YEARS, HAS NO OFFICE ABOVE IT, IS NOT OF THIS PARTY, IS NOT ON A LADDER AND IS NOT A VILLAIN, TOLD THE HOLDER OF THAT WRIT OF HER OWN ACCOUNT AND UNASKED, ON MONDAY THE TWENTY-SIXTH, THAT SHE HAD ONE SHEET ON THE TOP SHELF AT THE BACK OF THAT ROOM, ON ITS FACE OUT, THAT SHE HAD MADE IT NINE YEARS AGO FOR A MAN WHO WAS BUYING A HOUSE AND WANTED THE OLDEST PAPER THAT CAME WITH IT COPIED, AND THAT THE SAID MAN PAID AND DID NOT COME BACK FOR IT.** The question asked was *where in this town would a copy of a thing out of the drowned city be* and it was said out loud at her counter to be a question about where sheets are and not what is on one. **NOBODY ASKED HER ONE QUESTION ABOUT WHAT WAS ON IT, AND NOT ONCE, AND THE REASON AGAINST THE LINE OF THE ASKING IS THAT A SHEET A WOMAN HAS NOT READ IS A SHEET SHE HAS NOTHING TO ANSWER FOR, AND THAT THE HOLDER OF THAT WRIT IS NOT GOING TO BE THE MAN WHO MAKES HER READ ONE.**
4. **HER RULE IS THE VOLUME'S OWN ARGUMENT IN THE MOUTH OF AN ORDINARY PERSON, AND IT IS HER TRADE AND NOT A VIRTUE: I DO NOT READ WHAT I COPY.** The day a copyist finds out what a thing is she is a person who knows what it says, and a person who knows what a paper says is somebody's to ask, and a copyist cannot have a counter on a street and know what is on the shelf behind her own head. **She asked one thing for herself, in her own words, and it was that if he took the sheet off the shelf he was never to come back and tell her what was on it. He said he would not, and he did not, and she never turns it over and never will, and that is the whole of what a penny cost her and it is not nothing.**
5. **HE DID NOT BUY IT ON THE MONDAY, AND THE NOT-BUYING IS IN THE SECOND COLUMN AND NOT THE FIRST, and the reason against the line of the not-buying is not money and never has been in this yard; it is that the day was a Monday and that a person of no office had said on the Saturday at the bench that if he came up that hill with a story about a sheet in it she would stop coming up it. HE BOUGHT IT ON TUESDAY THE TWENTY-SEVENTH AT EIGHT IN THE MORNING FOR A PENNY, AND SHE PUT THE PENNY IN THE BOX AND DID NOT LOOK UP.**
6. **WHAT THE SHEET IS, AND IT IS A COPY AND NOT THE THING.** One sheet, about sixteen inches by eleven, of a heavy rag paper gone the color of a wet pipe, folded twice across and once down, with the middle fold soft and parting at one corner. **It is a copy, in the hand of the man who was buying the house, made nine years ago, copied entire on both sides with no lines ruled and no blot and nothing on it that was not on the original.** At the head of the face is the name of a chamber, and **this yard has not been able to place that name in any book in that shed or in the sheet rolled behind the tide table, and it goes in the first column because a name on a piece of paper is a thing a man can go and look at, and this yard is not sending for a book.** Under the head is a date, the eleventh day of a month, and **the month and the year are both on the line the fold has parted at, and the fold was not mended and the figure was not guessed at.**
7. **THE ORDER IS NINE LINES AND IT SAYS THE FLEET WAS ORDERED DOWN, AND IT IS COLLECTIVE AND DISPUTED AND IT IS NOT THE WORK OF A SINGLE RULER, AND IT SAYS NOTHING WHATEVER ABOUT WHY OR WHO.** The nine lines, in the copy's hand: the fleet is ordered down; the fleet is the transparent fleet and every vessel of it lies in the water of this city; the order is of the fleet and not of a master of it; the masters are not to be asked which of them made it; the order is carried by the masters and not by any office; no copy of this order is to be made; a copy of this order is not this order; a man holding a copy of this order has not got an order; and it is to be carried out in one tide. **THERE IS NO TENTH LINE. THE HOLDER OF THAT WRIT AND THE SHIP'S HAND EACH READ THE NINE LINES THREE TIMES AND NEITHER FOUND A TENTH, AND THE REASON AGAINST THE LINE OF THE READING OF THE TENTH IS THAT A COPYIST WHO COPIES NINE LINES OUT OF NINE DOES NOT LEAVE OUT THE TENTH.**
8. **THE MARKS AT THE FOOT ARE THE FINDING, AND THEY DO NOT AGREE WITH ONE ANOTHER, AND THAT IS NOT A DEFECT IN THE EVIDENCE.** There are nine of them. **Six are the same mark, a circle with one stroke struck through it, struck hard and struck even and all six of the same size and in the same hand. Two are the same mark and not that mark, the same circle with two strokes, struck smaller and off the center, and not even with each other, one harder than the other and a third of a size out. The ninth is not a struck mark at all: it is nine short lines in a group, cut and not struck, going about a third of the depth of the other eight, at an angle to the sheet that none of the other eight is at.** Under the nine, in the hand of the sheet and not the hand of the copy, there is one line: **and the ninth is not one of ours and is not to be counted with the nine and is not to be asked about.**
9. **THE NINE-LINE MARK APPEARS ONCE IN THIS BATCH, AS ONE OF SEVERAL MARKS ON AN OLD RECORD, DIFFERING FROM THE OTHERS, AND NO CHAPTER SAYS WHAT IT IS FOR.** In Chapter 288 this yard has its own nine-line mark in a book, it came up out of a wreck in the summer before last and it closed, and **what it closed as is carried on the page: that it is a builder's mark of a pre-Accord construction, that it is not a claim seal, that it is not a mark of consent, and that no office in Veyr can say what it means.** The two are the same shape and **THE YARD REFUSES OUT LOUD TO COUNT ONE WITH THE OTHER, TO GO TO A PRESSURE HOUSE AT TERNWATCH AND ASK A MAN THERE WHETHER HIS FOREMAN CUT CROSS-STROKE FIRST, TO WRITE TO A TOWN FOUR DAYS UP THAT COAST, AND TO PUT THE TWO OF THEM IN ONE LINE TOGETHER**, and the reason against each of those four lines is that a shape is not a thing and nobody in this country can go and look at either of them. **IT IS NOT RE-OPENED TO GET A DIFFERENT ANSWER.**
10. **THE READING WAS DONE BY TWO PEOPLE UNDER A LAMP AT ABOUT TEN IN THE EVENING OF THURSDAY THE TWENTY-NINTH, IN A SHED ON THAT MOLE, WITH THE DOOR SHUT AND THE MARKET OFF THE BOARDS, AND THERE WAS NOBODY ELSE IN THE ROOM. THE THIRD PERSON IS NOT IN THE ROOM AND IS THE ONE WHO MOST WANTS TO BE.** **A WOMAN OF NO OFFICE OF THIS HARBOR WAS ASKED ON THE WEDNESDAY EVENING AND SAID YES BEFORE HE HAD GOT TO THE END OF THE SENTENCE, AND WAS THEN TOLD SHE WAS NOT TO COME, AND WAS GIVEN THE REASON, WHICH IS THAT A ROOM WITH A LAMP IN IT OVER A SHEET A MAN CANNOT CHECK IS THE ROOM HER CERTIFICATE OF METHOD WAS FOR, AND THAT THE WHOLE STANDING OF SUCH A CERTIFICATE IS THAT A PERSON MAY SAY A THING UNDER THAT METHOD WHERE A THING IS ON A TABLE AND EVERY PERSON IN THAT ROOM MAY ACT ON IT, AND THAT HE IS NOT GOING TO PUT A METHOD'S WORDS ON THAT SHEET, AND THAT HE STOOD IN THAT SHED ON THE TWENTY-SECOND OF APRIL PAST AND WATCHED A THING HE HAS NO POWER TO GIVE BACK GET SPENT. SHE SAID THE OTHER HALF OF IT HERSELF AND IT WAS NOT IMPROVED ON BY EITHER OF THEM: she was not being left out because she was not able, she was being left out because she was the only one of the three who could say whether it was true, and if she said it then in about four years a man in a city would write *she said so* on the back of a sheet and a person who had held a certificate and had not got one any more would become the hand a thing rests on. SHE WAS IN THAT SHED AT SIX THE NEXT MORNING AND NOT AT NINE OR TEN, AND SHE WAS IN IT ON FIVE OF THE TEN DAYS OF THIS BATCH AND WAS NOT ASKED FOR ANYTHING ON ANY OF THEM. **THE FIVE ARE THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF APRIL, THE TWENTY-NINTH, THE THIRTIETH, THE SECOND OF MAY AND THE FOURTH, and the figure seven that this section and three other files previously carried is withdrawn; on the first and the third she was on that mole and not in that shed, and on the twenty-sixth, twenty-seventh, twenty-eighth and the first of May she was not in it.**
11. **THE TURN IS PAID IN TWO CHAPTERS AND IN TWO HALVES, AND IT IS SAID OUT LOUD TWICE AND THE CLOSE SAYS SO.** In Chapter 286, out loud, in that shed, on a Friday afternoon, to two people: **the thing this yard has been calling an office's fear for a year and a half was real, it happened to real people in real water, it was not one man's vanity and not a lie and not a weapon, and it was ordered by more than one of them, together, and they argued about it afterwards and left the argument on the paper, AND KNOWING IT DOES NOT MAKE ANYBODY SAFE.** In Chapter 290 it is said again out loud, in the same words and in the same order, to three people, and **the holder of that writ says out loud before he says it that he told them on the Friday that he was going to say it once and that he is saying it twice, and the reason given is that a thing said once to two people in a shed with the door shut is a story, and the same thing said to three people in the same room is a record, and that there is nothing in the difference except the number of people in the room.** The second half in Chapter 290: **the opacity was expensive for a reason, the reason is on a sheet in a drawer in this shed, and a reason is not a warrant; this yard does not get to be the one that says that office was right; the sheet is incomplete; and a party that says false about an incomplete record has stopped being the party that says what it is not.** **THE OFFICE'S THREE HUNDRED YEARS WAS NOT WITHDRAWN AND NOT SOFTENED, and the argument is that a party that says false about a record that is incomplete has stopped being the party that says what it is not, and THE CROWN'S HISTORY IS EXPOSED AS INCOMPLETE AND NOT AS FALSE, which is what the outline's concrete resolution asks for.** **IT IS ENTERED IN THE FIRST COLUMN ONCE, IN THE WORDS OF THE FRIDAY, AND NOTHING HAS BEEN ADDED TO IT SINCE.**
12. **THE THREE THINGS SAID ABOUT THE SHEET IN CHAPTER 290, AND ALL THREE ARE TRUE, AND THEY DIFFER IN WHAT THEY ARE ABOUT AND NOT IN WHETHER THEY ARE CORRECT.** The first, about the words, said by the holder of that writ: the order says the fleet was ordered down, it is nine lines and there is no tenth, the second and fourth lines say that no man is to be able to say it was his, that is in it and it cost a penny, and **he has not got one word of who wanted it and is not going to have it, and this is about half of an answer and the half that is missing is a name.** The second, about the marks, said by the ship's hand: six and two and a ninth, and **if those two marks had been one mark there would be nothing on that sheet but a decision, and a decision with one mark on it is a thing a man can repeat, and this is not, because these people argued about it afterwards, so the marks are the finding and the marks are not a resolution.** The third, about the house, said by the woman of no office: a drawer in a shed, bought for a penny off a shelf, and **none of the three of us is a keeper and all three of us are, and that is not a puzzle, that is a chair, and the chair is in a house, and a house is a place a person cannot refuse anybody anything about, and there is no handle on the inside of any of the three of them.**
13. **THE SECOND DESCENT WAS BOUGHT AND NOT FOUND, IT WAS NAMED BEFORE IT WAS AGREED TO, AND IT CAME TO THE SAME FIGURE AS THE EIGHTH, NINTH AND TENTH OF APRIL PAST, COMPONENT FOR COMPONENT — AND THE FIGURE *DEARER* IS WITHDRAWN FROM THE FACE OF THIS FILE AND WAS NEVER TRUE.** **WITHDRAWN FIGURE, NAMED AS THE BATCH'S OWN RULE REQUIRES: this section previously read *THE SECOND DESCENT WAS BOUGHT AND NOT FOUND AND IT WAS DEARER, AND IT WAS NAMED BEFORE IT WAS AGREED TO, AND THE DEARER IS A FIGURE.* The dearer does not exist. `chapter-0266.md` and `chapter-0270.md` already carry the descent of the eighth, ninth and tenth of April past at the identical **fourteen marks, three shillings and fourpence, being two thousand two hundred and eighty pence**, with the identical four components, including a second man off that Crown house book at two marks and eightpence a day, and the holder of that writ says out loud on the Tuesday that the book sends the same man every time. The price did not move and could not have moved. WHAT IS TRUE AND WHAT THE CHAPTERS NOW SAY is that the same four figures are bought again off the same book out of the same pressure house at Ternwatch, that the said holder would not improve on them, that **the reason a second man is off that book at all is not that the figure is higher and is that he cannot hold a slate and read a figure at the same time**, and that **what cost more the second time was not the set and was a third party's six fathoms of gear and the holder of that writ's own right hand for two hours and a half, and neither of those carries a money figure.** No cost is paid twice and no figure is reduced. One day off the south end of that mole and round the corner from the bar, at about forty fathoms, the pot down at about twenty past nine and up at about ten to twelve, two hours and fifty minutes in the water, **the same set off the same book out of the same pressure house at Ternwatch, and a second man off that book at two marks and eightpence on top of the same three figures, because one man is not enough to hold a pot and read a figure at forty fathoms and the yard's own hand is the hand that cannot hold a slate, and the holder of that writ said that out loud at that bench on the Tuesday evening before anybody agreed to a single thing.** **The gauge is a pressure gauge on a face of a hundred and fifty and read eighty-four pounds, as it read on the eighth, ninth and tenth of April past, and the pencil mark where the needle stood on the tenth was NOT MOVED, and that is the only reason the two books are the same book.** The six conditions of a first entry were read aloud at the boat in order, there was no first entry, **there is no harbor authority's book to go in and this yard's own book is not that book**, and the bar of four hundred yards off the outer marks was named out loud at the boat and is not narrowed and was not asked to be, and **no person, no boat and no lead of that yard was inside that bar on the said day or on any day of this batch.**
14. **WHAT THE DESCENT FOUND WAS A JOIN, AND A JOIN SAYS DIFFERENCE AND NOT TRUTH, AND IT SETTLED NOTHING.** **A FIGURE IS CUT AT THE NEAR END OF EVERY COURSE ON THAT FLOOR AND THE FIGURE IN THE TOP COURSE IS THE FORTY-SECOND, AND IT IS CUT ABOUT A QUARTER OF AN INCH DEEP WHERE THE OTHER FORTY-ONE ARE CUT ABOUT AN INCH DEEP, AND ITS STROKES ARE LAID ON CROSS-STROKE FIRST.** That is a difference in a made thing and it says the thing was made in two hands at two times and it says nothing whatever about which of them is right, or why, or by whom. **The holder of that writ said out loud in that boat that the figure was to be written down as what it is and not as what it means, and the reason against the line of the saying is that a figure a man cannot check from a mole is a figure and not a finding. AND HE DID NOT WRITE IT. THE SHIP'S HAND ENTERED IT IN HER OWN LEFT HAND AND HE DID NOT TOUCH THE SLATE AND DID NOT CHECK THE ENTRY, and at about four o'clock on the said day he had the slate in his left hand and the pencil in his right and could do neither, and gave the slate across the thwart, and said out loud that he could hold a compass and could not hold that, and that he had told them he would not find out on the bottom which of the two he loses and had found out on the top of it instead in two hours and a half.**
15. **THE DESCENT COST A THIRD PARTY SIX FATHOMS AND IT WAS TOLD OUT LOUD ON THE MOLE STEPS IN ABOUT NINE PEOPLE'S HEARING ON SATURDAY THE FIRST OF MAY, AND NOTHING WAS PAID.** **THE LEAD WEIGHT OF THE POT CAME DOWN ACROSS THE BELLY OF ELIAS VOKE'S NET ON THE MILE'S OWN FLOOR AND ABOUT SIX FATHOMS OF IT IS NOW FLAT ON A COURSE OF CUT STONE UNDER A WEIGHT AND IS NOT CUT AND IS NOT MENDED AND WILL NOT COME UP WHOLE.** Nobody in that boat cut it, the ground is that man's by first refusal, he was not asked and was not sent for and was not in that boat, **and this yard had done the whole of it right — the six conditions read, the price named before, the day in the first column with a reason against the line — and it has still cost him six fathoms of gear, and the entry is in the first column and not the second, and the holder of that writ said so in that boat and would not put it anywhere else.** Voke said one thing and asked for nothing: **six, and not about six, because about is what a man writes when he wants to be argued with.** He also said out loud that he was not going to be thanked and that not being thanked is the arrangement, and **that the same sentence about a man this yard has paid is going round forty people and nine steps and that this yard does not have a speech, it has a sentence.** No money went to him and none is going to.
16. **THE COPY HAS NOW GOT ITS SIXTH DOOR AND THE SEVENTH IS A DRAWER, AND THE BATCH ENTERS THE COUNT.** The tin, a wall, the ordinary post, the four people of that coast, the counter off the fish market, and a fire. **The burning is the keeping and it is the same door, and the woman of no office said that out loud in that shed on the eighteenth of April past and nobody improved on it then and nobody improved on it now.** And it is a drawer in that shed, and **a drawer is a house, and a yard is a house, and this shed is a house, and this yard said all of that out loud on the twenty-fourth of April past and meant it, and on the twenty-seventh of April it went down the hill and put a penny on a counter, and here it is.** The whole of what the sheet cost is a penny, a drawer, and the rest of a woman's life not knowing what is on it.
17. **THE NEW QUESTION IS ASKED OUT LOUD AT A MOLE HEAD BY A PERSON OF NO OFFICE AND IS NOT ANSWERED BY ANYBODY.** On Monday the third of May, at about half past ten in the morning, in about nine people's hearing, and she said in advance that there is no person in it and she wanted it written down that there is no person in it: **who was the first one to use a mark like that to keep a thing instead of holding it.** **The holder of that writ said out loud that he does not know and that there is nobody in this country he could ask, and that he is not going to write to a town to find out, and that he is not going to ask the four people four days down that coast, and the reason against the line of the finding is the reason of the second day of April last about a trade and a price. THE QUESTION GOES IN NO COLUMN OF THAT YARD'S OWN BOOK AND IS ON NO WALL IN THAT HARBOR AND CARRIES NO FIGURE, and no chapter of this batch answers it and no chapter of this movement may.** The fourth column takes it: a question asked on a mole head is not a thread and does not go in that book, because a question a man in a city can read and repeat is a question that gets an office to ask it back.
18. **THE MARKET IS NOT USED AND THE MARKET WALL IS NOT TOUCHED.** The market and the hearing room are neither the same day nor present in this batch. The one public thing in these ten days is a question on a mole steps in about nine people's hearing on the third of May, and a thing told out loud on the same steps on the first of May in about nine people's hearing, and **no person of that yard was in the fish market of that harbor on any of the ten days and nobody was sent to one, and the standing of a certificate of method in a market is not restored and is not going to be.**
19. **THE LEAF'S FOUR COUNTS AT THE CLOSE OF THIS BATCH ARE TWENTY-THREE ENTRIES IN THE FIRST COLUMN, EIGHTY-EIGHT LINES IN THE SECOND, NONE IN THE THIRD, AND EIGHTEEN IN THE FOURTH.** The first column is thirteen plus nine plus one, the nine being one for every day from the twenty-fifth of April to the third of May, and it read TWENTY-TWO at the read-back at about four on the fourth of May, before that day's own entry went in at about half past nine in the evening. The second column is forty-eight plus thirty-one plus nine, and the thirty-one is the sum of the lines entered on the twenty-fifth, twenty-sixth, twenty-seventh, twenty-eighth, twenty-ninth and thirtieth of April and on the first, second and third of May, being 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 3 and 3, and the nine of the fourth of May are the read-back's own. The fourth column is eleven plus seven, the seven being the lines of the twenty-fifth, twenty-seventh, twenty-ninth and thirtieth of April and of the second, third and fourth of May, and the fourth column's eighteenth line is the line of the fourth of May and is the last thing in that book.
20. **THE CONVERGENCE OPENS NOBODY'S DOOR AND IS INSIDE ITS TWO MONTHS.** About sixty boats on this coast have a copy of that yard's printed sheet of thirty-eight lines and the thirty-eighth line says where every other copy is, and a woman in that harbor said a thing out loud in a market on the twenty-second of April that about forty people heard and about nine people heard repeated on a mole on the third of May, and **in about seven weeks from the fourth of May those two things are going to meet somewhere that is not this yard, and this yard is not going to be the one that moves them along, and it is entered with no figure against it.**

### 3. What did not move, and may not be moved

**THE CHANDLER'S NOTE AT THIRTY-ONE, NOT RE-WRITTEN, ITS THREE COUNTS OF WEEKS AT TWENTY-TWO, THIRTEEN AND ELEVEN UNMOVED BY ARITHMETIC, AND IT WAS NOT SAID OUT LOUD A FIFTH TIME. THE DELAYED NOTE AT ELEVEN LOGGED OCCASIONS AND TWO OF THEM WITH NO CALL IN THEM, A HAND'S WIDTH OF A SECOND, NOTHING MEASURED, NO OCCASION ENTERED, AND THE ANSWER INSIDE IT NOT APPROACHED. THE NOTICE OF THE THIRTY-FIRST OF OCTOBER PAST WITH ITS FOUR CLAUSES, NOT LIFTED, NARROWED, RE-SERVED OR ALTERED, AND NO PERSON, NO BOAT AND NO LEAD OF THAT YARD INSIDE ITS FIRST CLAUSE ON ANY OF THE TEN DAYS EXCEPT THE ONE DAY THAT IS ENTERED IN THE FIRST COLUMN WITH THE REASON AGAINST THE LINE AND THE WHOLE PRICE NAMED THE EVENING BEFORE, BEING THE TWENTY-EIGHTH OF APRIL. FOUR RETURNS AND NO FIFTH, AND NO RETURN OF ANY KIND MADE OUT OF ANY OF THE TEN DAYS, AND NO FINDING OF WORKED GLASS MADE IN ANY OF THEM. THE PLATE IN ELEVEN FEET, NOT REACHED, NOT MEASURED, NOT TOUCHED, NOT ASKED ABOUT, NOTE OPEN FOR A THIRD VOLUME. THE CASE OF FIVE BELLS, NOT RAISED, NOT ASKED ABOUT, AND THE LIMIT FOUR PEOPLE OF THAT COAST WROTE AND SIGNED STANDS, AND THE HOLDER DID NOT ASK TO HAVE IT LIFTED ONCE IN THESE TEN DAYS. THE LEAD PLUG AND THE CHEST AND THE UNDERTAKING OF THE SECOND OF JULY; THE BELLWRIGHT WAS NOT ASKED IN ANY OF THESE TEN DAYS AND NO DIGIT OF ANYTHING HE SAID IS PRINTED. THE THIRD COLUMN, UNFILLED, UNAPPOINTED, THE BOY'S HAND AT THE HEAD OF IT, AND THE FOUR NAMELESS LINES ABOVE HIS NAMED LINE STILL FOUR, STILL NAMELESS, NOT STRUCK OUT, AND IN ABOUT SIXTY BOATS. THE FORTY MARKS TWICE, STANDING WHOLE AND FIRST AFTER FOOD, NEITHER REDUCED AND NEITHER PAID, AND NOT MENTIONED ONCE IN THESE TEN DAYS. THE COMPARTMENT SPENT, THE THREE GANNET DOCUMENTS STILL THREE, THE MANIFEST'S DISCREPANCY UNUSED, THE COAST ROAD UNRESOLVED AND THE KETTLE NOT LOOKED AT, THE THREE FIGURES NOT SWAPPED, THE SIXTH OCCASION NOT TO TELL AND THE UNDERTAKING NOT TO INVENT A SECOND ONE. THE WRIT, THE CHARTER, THE SEASON THAT ENDED ON THE THIRTY-FIRST OF MARCH WITH NOTHING ISSUED, THE FOUR-HUNDRED-YARD BAR, AND THE SECOND BELL ELIGIBILITY, WHICH IS NOT RESTORED, NOT APPLIED FOR AND NOT MOVED ONTO ANYTHING. THE CHAIN OF CUSTODY, A JURISDICTION AND A PRACTICE AND NOT A REGISTRY, MADE ON THE SIXTH OF MARCH PAST AND NOT AGED BY THIS OR ANY OTHER TEN DAYS; THIS YARD DID NOT LOOK IN ONE OF THE FOUR DRAWERS IT CANNOT LOOK IN AND WROTE TO NOBODY. THE BOY WAS NOT ON THE STONE ON ANY OF THE TEN DAYS, CAME DOWN ON NONE OF THEM, WAS PUT ON NOTHING, WAS NOT ASKED ONE WORD ABOUT THE OMISSIONS HE HAS ENTERED, AND NO NAME OF HIS IS IN ANY COLUMN OF THAT BOOK. THE FAR BENCH, ALDEN MARR, TOBIAS WREN, ORS KEST, THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-ONE OF THE THIRD LAY, AMOS SEARLE, CORVIN SARN, WEND BRACE, ILSE BRACE, THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-EIGHT AND THE BELLWRIGHT'S CHEST ARE ALL EXACTLY WHERE BATCH 0003 LEFT THEM, AND NOBODY WAS ASKED ANYTHING OF ANY OF THEM.**

**AND THE REVEALS: THE WORD *CROWN SEAL* APPEARS NOWHERE IN CHAPTERS 281 TO 290 AND MAY NOT BE NAMED BEFORE CHAPTER 291. THE OFFICE OF RETURNING MEMORY IS NOT NAMED. NO ONE OF THE NINE FINAL ROUTES IS NAMED IN THE PROSE. THE WORD *QUIETENING* APPEARS ONLY IN CHAPTER 281, TWICE, BOTH TIMES IN THE SAME OCCASION IN A CHARACTER'S MOUTH, AND NOWHERE ELSE IN THE TEN CHAPTERS AND NOWHERE EARLIER IN VOLUME 06. NO SENIOR EXAMINER, NO MAGISTRATE AND NO OFFICER OF THE NAVY IS A FACE ON ANY PAGE OF THIS BATCH; HALVEN ROOK IS NAMED ONCE AND IT IS ON A SEAL LINE AT THE FOOT OF A FORM ON A STEP TWO DAYS DOWN THAT COAST AND HE IS IN NO ROOM; CAPTAIN VEYRA HOLT IS NOWHERE. NO OFFICE ANSWERS ANYTHING IN A ROOM. NO CLERK IN A COPYING ROOM EXPLAINS WHAT THE SHEET DOES — A COPYIST OF THIS HARBOR REFUSES TO READ WHAT SHE COPIES, SAYS WHY IN HER OWN TRADE'S WORDS, AND IS ASKED NOTHING. NO ONE OF THE FOUR PEOPLE OF THAT COAST WAS ASKED FOR ANYTHING, THE COMPLAINT WAS NOT RAISED, AND THE FACT THAT A COPY OF A MUNICIPAL ORDER CAME OUT OF A DROWNED CITY FOR A PENNY IS NOT A REASON TO ASK THEM AND WAS NOT USED AS ONE. NO CHAPTER STATES WHO WANTED ANYTHING, AT WHOSE INSTANCE ANYTHING WAS DONE, OR WITH WHAT INTENT, AND THE SHEET ITSELF NAMES NOBODY. THERE IS NO PANEL, STAT BLOCK, CHARACTER SHEET, STATUS MESSAGE, FLOATING TEXT, QUEST TEXT, SKILL TREE, LEVEL-UP OR SOFTWARE VOCABULARY, NO SECOND PERSON ADDRESSING THE READER, AND NOTHING ON ANY PAGE KNOWS ANYTHING. The fourth column is eighteen plus seven, the seven being the lines of the fifth, seventh, eighth, eleventh, twelfth, thirteenth and fourteenth, and the fourteenth's is the twenty-fifth line and is the last thing in that book.

### 2. The new canon of this batch

1. **THE CROWN SEAL IS NAMED, AND IT IS NAMED FIRST IN CHAPTER 291, IN A CHARACTER'S MOUTH, IN A SHED, AND IT IS A MECHANISM AND NOT A PERSON AND NOT A VILLAIN AND NOT A MARK ON A PAPER.** It is a round of glass about the size of a saucer in a metal collar with a wheel in the collar and a screw through it; it sits in a bed cut in a sill; the screw goes down onto the bed and takes a load off a thing made of the same glass as itself; **the mark of its name is cut into the round and the round is the mark, and the collar is what holds the mark on, and the collar is a good collar and the screw goes in about two turns and stops.** And it is **a term and not a lock**: whoever cut it wanted a thing held and wanted it held for so long and no longer, and cut a figure on the sill so that the next man would know when, and **the only man who ever looks at one is whoever comes next, and there is nobody in this country who comes next.** It is named by a retired salvage foreman of sixty-one because he has seen one and not because he knows anything, he says so, he is asked nothing further, **and the yard does not enter the word in the first column, and the reason is that a man's memory of a thing he saw a long time ago is a thing a man can go and look at exactly once.**
2. **THE CHAMBER IS AT ABOUT SEVENTY FATHOOMS OFF THE SOUTH END OF THAT MOLE, ROUND THE CORNER FROM THE BAR, IN A CUT FACE OF ABOUT THIRTY FEET, WITH A DOORWAY FIVE FEET HIGH AND A ROOM ABOUT NINE FEET ACROSS.** The sill is a dressed stone about four feet long and the width of a hand; there is a bed cut its whole length about two inches deep and the width of two fingers; **and under the lip of the sill there is a second groove, deeper and wider, which is a rebate and not a bed**; and a plate of glass about the width of the doorway and a hand and a half high and the thickness of two fingers stands in the bed and not in the rebate, and the bed is empty. It is at seventy fathoms and not at forty, and the mole's own floor with its forty-two figures is at forty and is a mile and a quarter round the corner from this and is not confused with it on any page.
3. **THE FIGURE AND THE DAY ARE ON THE SILL AND A MAN CAN GO AND LOOK AT THEM. IN THE INNER FACE OF THE SILL TO THE LEFT OF THE BED THERE IS A ROW OF TWO HUNDRED AND NINE MARKS, CUT ONE UNDER ANOTHER IN THE SAME HAND AS THE FIGURES AT THE NEAR END OF EVERY COURSE ON THAT MOLE'S OWN FLOOR, WITH ONE FURTHER CUT BELOW THE ROW, DEEPER AND NOT THE SAME CUT; AND BESIDE THE ROW THERE IS A DAY CUT IN THE SAME HAND AND THE SAME STROKE, BEING THE ELEVENTH OF MAY. THE ROW WAS COUNTED THREE TIMES BY TWO PEOPLE AND ALL THREE COUNTS WERE THE SAME, AND BOTH THE ROW AND THE DAY ARE IN THE FIRST COLUMN BECAUSE A MAN IN A BOAT CAN GO AND LOOK AT THEM AND NOT BECAUSE ANYBODY KNOWS WHAT THEY MEAN.**
4. **THE CHAMBER CLOSES. AT ABOUT A QUARTER PAST TWO ON THE ELEVENTH OF MAY THE PLATE WENT DOWN INTO THE REBATE, AND IT IS NOT COMING UP, AND THE REBATE IS DEEPER THAN THE BED BY THE THICKNESS OF THE PLATE, AND NOTHING IS HOLDING IT UP. NOBODY IN THE BOAT SAW THE BEGINNING OF IT AND A MAN IN A BOAT COULD SEE THE END OF IT, AND A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-FIVE OF TERNWATCH PUT IT IN THE BOOK IN THE YARD'S OWN WORDS: THAT IS WHAT A FIGURE CUT IN A SILL IS FOR.**
5. **THE ROUND OF GLASS IS THE MECHANISM AND IT CARRIED A SEAL. IT CAME UP ON THE SEVENTH OF MAY FROM THE FLOOR OF THE CHAMBER, LYING ON AND BEDDED IN A PIECE OF WORKED GLASS ABOUT THE SIZE OF A HAND WHICH WOULD NOT COME AWAY FROM IT AND WENT UP WITH IT, AND NOBODY READS THE MARKS ON IT AND NOBODY SCRATCHED AT IT.** **AND ON ITS COLLAR THERE IS A CHAIN OF ELEVEN LINKS ABOUT A FINGER LONG, EVERY LINK STAMPED AND A DATE STAMPED ON EVERY LINK, THE LAST LINK THICKER THAN THE OTHER TEN — AND THAT IS THE OLD EVIDENCE CHAIN, AND IT IS ENTERED IN THE FIRST COLUMN ON THE TWELFTH OF MAY.**
6. **THE SEAL LINE ON THE LAST LINK, READ ON THE TWELFTH OF MAY BY HOLDING A FLAT PIECE OF GLASS TO THE LIGHT SO AS NOT TO SCRATCH AT IT, READS: *Sealed and entered at the Morrow circuit office by order of Magister Ilya Serr, senior Registry examiner.*** **A DATE IS STRUCK ON THE OUTSIDE OF THE COLLAR AND THAT DATE IS LATER THAN THE STRIKE ON THAT LINK, AND THE COLLAR IS THE WORK OF THE SAME OFFICE NAMED ON THE SEAL LINE, AND THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE TWO IS A DIFFERENCE IN TWO MADE THINGS AND SAYS NOTHING WHATEVER ABOUT WHICH OF THEM IS RIGHT, OR WHY, OR BY WHOM.** **HE IS IN NO ROOM, ON NO MOLE, IN NO MARKET AND NOT IN THIS HARBOR. HE WAS NOT SENT FOR AND WAS NOT ASKED ANYTHING, AND THE NAME ON THAT LINE IS A LINE AND IS NOT A MAN, AND IT IS SPOKEN ALOUD EXACTLY ONCE IN THE TEN CHAPTERS, IN THAT SHED ON THE FOURTEENTH OF MAY, BY THE SHIP'S HAND READING THE THIRTEEN BACK IN THE FLAT VOICE SHE USES FOR A COLUMN, AND BY NOBODY ELSE; ON THE TWELFTH IT WAS READ OFF THE LINK AND NOT SAID OUT LOUD, AND CHAPTER 298 NOW SAYS EXACTLY THAT.** The name appears on two pages of the batch, in Chapter 298 and in the fourth of the thirteen in Chapter 300, and in no scene and in no mouth.
7. **THE DESCENT IS BOUGHT AND IT IS NOT PAID FOR BY THIS YARD, AND THE REASON IS THE BATCH'S OWN MORAL HINGE. THE DAY'S PLANT AND AIR CAME OFF A BOOK AT A PRESSURE HOUSE AT TERNWATCH, AT THE IDENTICAL FIGURE OF THE EIGHTH, NINTH, TENTH AND TWENTIETH-EIGHTH OF APRIL PAST, BEING FOURTEEN MARKS, THREE SHILLINGS AND FOURPENCE, AND NOT ONE PENNY OF IT WENT OUT OF THAT YARD'S OWN BOOK, BECAUSE A MAN OF SIXTY-ONE WITH A BOAT THAT IS NOT THAT YARD'S ASKED FOR IT.** And the holder of that writ said out loud, before agreeing to it, that **a man this yard has paid is a man this yard can be asked about and he does not know what a man this yard is being paid by is and has not got a rule for it.** The man of sixty-one said that was not enough and that he was not going to improve on it.
8. **THE CROWN HOUSE BOOK SENDS AMOS SEARLE AND THE YARD SAYS NO OUT LOUD.** He is carried on that book as unfit for five weeks from the ninth of April and as fit for light work after and as fit on the fifth of June; the reason is entered as a book and not as care of a man and is the ninth and the twenty-eighth of April; the second name on the book was sent at the same two marks and eightpence a day and the figure did not move, and the man of about thirty-four of that house said that he had not come four hundred miles to argue about fourpence.
9. **THE GLASS STORM IS ON THE PAGE, IT IS USED, AND NO CAUSE IS NAMED FOR IT IN ANY VOLUME.** It came out of the south-west at about four in the afternoon on the seventh of May and did not stop until about ten that night. **The skylight of that shed, the door light of it, a pane of plate about four feet by three out of a shopfront on that front, the running glass of two boats inside the harbor line, eleven windows along that front and the lens of the mole-head light all went.** About a hundred people were out in the rain and nobody was hurt. **IT IS IN TWO HANDS ON TWO PAGES THAT ARE NOT ON TOP OF EACHING: the first in the ship's hand in that yard's own second column on the mole, the second in a man of sixty-one's own hand in his own book in the house of his own boat four streets off the front of that harbor, brought up that mole unasked on the Sunday afternoon at about one and not on top of the first page, and in about four years it is the only record in the country of what that front looked like.** **THE SECOND PAGE IS NOT IN A BOAT A MILE AND A QUARTER OFF THAT MOLE, WHICH CHAPTER 293 SAID TWICE ON ITS OWN FACE AND WHICH THE REVIEW REPAIRS BELOW CORRECT: A MILE AND A QUARTER IS THE STANDING DISTANCE FROM THE HEAD OF THAT MOLE TO THE FRONT, AND THE PAGE IS IN A BOOK FOUR STREETS OFF, AND CHAPTERS 295 AND 300 AND THIS FILE ALWAYS SAID SO.** The reason against the line of naming a cause is that a yard which cannot check a thing does not get to name what made it. **IT IS THE REASON NO PERSON DOES WHAT THEY DO ON ANY PAGE OF THIS BATCH.**
10. **TOBIAS WREN IS INJURED IN THE RIGHT HAND AND DOES NOT DIE, AND IT IS PAID IN THREE PARTS IN THREE PLACES.** **The hand:** a pane of plate glass went over on the crown of that mole on the eighth of May at about half past seven in the morning across the right hand of a man of sixty-one edge first, once, while two men were lifting a sheet that had lain there since the evening before. **It is the right hand, and Amos Searle's left shoulder and left ribs are not this and are not used to discharge it.** **The bill:** a bonesetter of about sixty of this harbor, thirty-one years and about four hundred things, who came down the hill because he does not go up one, who said the palm and not the back, who said the hand will grip again by the middle of June and about two-thirds of what it gripped on the Friday and about nine parts in ten by Christmas, **who did not say no, who is not going to be asked twice, and who is not going to hear a word about who brought him**; **a mark and four shillings, being two hundred and eight pence, paid out of that yard's own book at about twenty past ten in the morning at a counter over a chandler's.** **The absence and the consequence:** a man of sixty-one gives the figure himself and will not be argued out of it, being that he will not be on the water until the second day of June, and that the job on the north bar on the nineteenth of May is not going to happen; **and his boat of about nineteen tons, which he built himself fifty years ago or near it, has taken a stove on the night of the seventh in the weather, nobody saw it and nobody has said what caused it, and eleven pieces of her frame came out of her on the Saturday and are on the crown of that mole and are not going back in.** **He was not thanked and said he was not going to be, and the yard entered that it has a rule about a man it has paid and has not got a rule about a man it has hurt.** He is not a teacher, he is not a door, he is not asked about the sealed case, the lead plug, the bellwright's chest or anything in Volume 03, and the one thing he says about the shackle on the thirteenth is that he has seen the make and is not going to say either of the two things he could say about it.
11. **THE LETTING. THE DECISION WAS TAKEN ON THE FIFTH OF MAY AT ABOUT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON, BEFORE ANYBODY HAD AGREED TO ANYTHING, AND THE PRICE WAS NAMED IN THE SAME BREATH, AND IT WAS CARRIED OUT ON THE ELEVENTH, AND NOBODY IN BETWEEN WAS ASKED.** On the fifth: **if there is a chamber down there and if it is open enough to be read, this yard will not read it and will not take one piece of it out, and the reason is that a record a man cannot check is worth less than nothing and this yard has said that in six movements out loud.** The price named then: **the only proof this yard will ever have of anything about a drowned city will be in a thing that closed, and this yard will lose it on a day when it wanted it and will not be able to prove that it ever had it.** On the seventh the round was taken out of the bed with the plate standing on it with nothing behind it. On the eleventh **the round was carried down the mole steps in the open air in front of about nine people, stood in two hands on the stone of the steps, and was not put back**, and the holder of that writ said the sentence: **the chamber closes whether it is read or not, and we are letting it close.** And the woman of no office said the other half out loud: **that is not a surrender and it is not a proof, and nobody in that boat is going to say this yard was right about it, because it does not know that it was right about it, and what it costs and what it is worth are not the same figure and the second one is zero.** Nobody wrote it on the day and it went in at about half past nine that night with all three of them standing at the bench.
12. **THE ROUND OF GLASS IS GIVEN TO A PERSON OF NO OFFICE AND GOES UP THAT COAST IN A DRAWER IN HER HAND, AND THAT IS THE VOLUME'S FINAL CHAPTER IMAGE.** She goes up on the seventeenth of May in a boat going for coal and for a sheet of hers in a drawer in a town four days up that coast in somebody else's keeping, and on the eighteenth the round is in a drawer in her hand in that town, **and it is a separate object and is NOT a piece cut out of the plate that has closed: the round is a collar-mounted disc that was lifted off the floor of the room and bedded in a separate piece of worked glass about the size of a hand, and the plate is still standing in the sill and went down into the rebate on the eleventh and is not coming up, and THE FIGURE *A PIECE CUT OUT OF THE PLATE THAT HAS CLOSED* AND *THE PLATE AND THE PIECE ARE ONE THING* ARE WITHDRAWN BY THE REVIEW REPAIRS BELOW, BECAUSE CHAPTERS 293, 294, 297 AND 298 KEEP THE TWO APART AND THE STATE FILES HAD ADOPTED ONE CHAPTER'S ERROR OVER THE CHAPTERS' OWN FACTS.** She is not thanked and is not asked and nothing is given to her and her forty marks first after food are not reduced, are not paid, and are not paid by a round of glass. **THE ROUND DID NOT GO INTO THAT SHED AND IS NOT GOING INTO ANY SHED, because the second clause of the notice of the thirty-first of October past keeps recovered transparent mineral out of every shed in this harbor and this yard did not write it and cannot lift it.**
13. **CALDER LOSES A PORTION OF HIS OWN RECALL, PERMANENTLY, ON THE TWELFTH OF MAY, AND THERE IS NO FIGURE FOR IT.** He could not say one of the nine lines of the order, having read them under a lamp on the twenty-ninth of April and not since. **The sheet is in the drawer in that shed, and the ship's hand read the nine lines out in about ninety seconds and he had them again, and a thing relearned off a sheet in ninety seconds is not a thing remembered, and the record outlives the man and the man does not outlive the record.** It goes in the second column with the twelfth of May against it and a reason against the line and **no name in it, and the reason against the line of putting a name to it is that a name given to a thing once is a name somebody will use the next time it happens, and the reason against the line of calling it the thing it is not is that the thing it is not has a reason against its own line and this one has not got one and is not going to be given it.** **IT IS NOT A STAGE AND IT IS NOT THE CONDITION, AND THE CONDITION IS NAMED NOWHERE IN THIS BATCH AND THE NAMING IS NOT REVIVED.**
14. **THE CONCEALMENT IS TOLD ONCE AND ONCE ONLY, IN A ROOM WITH TWO PEOPLE IN IT AND NOBODY ELSE, ON MONDAY THE TENTH OF MAY, AND NEITHER OF THEM CALLS IT A REUNION.** **The price is named before he starts and it is hers: say it twice.** The first time was a shed at half past ten at night in about nine seconds in a voice he told her he could not have repeated, and she has never been able to use it. **What is told is the Oren mark: a sound, not a crack and not a number, coming up out of the bottom of this harbor in a ground line's delay, three marks and a flick, in a call a boy on a quay used to answer him with when they were eleven, known since the fourteenth of October, and it is his brother's, and it is the reason he went into that shard on the thirteenth of October, and it is in no record, in no office, in no book and not in any chart.** Four things she will not do and says so: it does not restore the standing of a certificate of method in a market, which was spent on the twenty-second of April and cannot be given back; her forty marks first after food are not reduced and not paid and were not paid by a thing said in a room; he is not going to be forgiven and did not ask; **and she is not going to be able to do it again, and he has known that since the second of January and has said nothing for four months, and she is not going to give him the fifth thing.** It goes in no column, on no wall, and into no book.
15. **THE THREE STATEMENTS OF THE THIRTEENTH, ABOUT THREE DIFFERENT THINGS, ALL THREE TRUE, AND NONE OF THEM THE SAME AS CHAPTER 290'S THREE.** Chapter 290 spoke about **the words, the marks and the house.** Chapter 299 speaks about **the sill, the round and the room.** The ship's hand, about the sill: two hundred and nine marks and a day, a chamber was held and the holding had a term and no man read it, and nobody is going to write *because* anywhere near any of it. The woman of no office, about the round: **a machine that holds a room open for a term so that somebody has to go and look at it is the most sensible thing she has ever heard of, and they were right, and a reason is not a warrant, and this yard does not get to be the one that says that office was right**, and the two figures — nine communities and six centuries, and three hundred years of the office that answers it — are not in one another's sentence. The holder of that writ, about the room: **nine communities' votes held in one room that could not all be true together, a hazard and not an archive, and the proof this yard has is physical and labor-based and about half of it is unreadable**; and a man of about thirty-four at Ternwatch asks whether the proof was made and is told that the yard has proved that the thing the offices of this country say they are guarding against is a room, and has not proved what was in it, and **a party that says false about an incomplete record has stopped being the party that says what it is not.**
16. **THE THIRTEEN THINGS, READ OUT OF THE LEAF AT ABOUT FOUR ON THE FOURTEENTH OF MAY AND ENTERED WITHOUT ADDITION, OF WHICH THE FOURTH AND THE THIRTEENTH ARE THE TWO THE YARD IS HELD TO.** They are set out in full at `state/chapter-summaries.md` § *Volume 06, Batch 0005*, Chapter 300. The fourth is the seal line and the fact that no such person is in a room. **The thirteenth is the poverty, and it says that a working harbor of that coast is poorer on the fourteenth day of May than it was on the twenty-third day of February, and that the four returns are four and there is no fifth, and the five drawers are five drawers, and the plate in eleven feet is in eleven feet with its note open, and the forty marks stand twice, and the wage column stands, and a yard has two hundred and sixty-one pence in a drawer on a mole.**
17. **THE NEW-VOLUME QUESTION IS NOT ASKED AGAIN AND IS NOT ANSWERED.** It was asked out loud on the mole steps on the third of May by a person of no office in about nine people's hearing and **it has not been answered by anybody in eleven days and is not going to be answered by anybody in this yard**, and it goes in no column of that book and on no wall in that harbor and carries no figure. **A new antagonist is not opened by it. It is a question about a practice, the practice is that office's, the office is already the antagonist, and Ilya Serr is already the final enemy.**
18. **THE NAME AT THE HEAD OF THE THIRD COLUMN WAS SAID OUT LOUD ONCE IN THIS BATCH AND IT IS MARA VENN, and it was said once, in a boat, on the thirteenth of May at about eleven in the morning, and it had not been said out loud before, and the ship's hand said it once and refused to say it again, and neither brother was asked anything about it.** The boy's hand is at the head of that column and is not scratched out, the column is not filled on any of the ten days, nobody is appointed to it, nobody is hired to read a position back, **and no name of the boy of twenty-two is in any column of that book and none has ever been.**
19. **THE CONVERGENCE IS NOT TOUCHED AND IS NOT MOVED ALONG.** About sixty boats on this coast have a copy of that yard's sheet of thirty-eight lines and the thirty-eighth line says where every other copy is, and a woman in that harbor said a thing out loud in a market on the twenty-second of April that about forty people heard. **IN ABOUT SEVEN WEEKS FROM THE FOURTEENTH OF MAY THOSE TWO THINGS ARE GOING TO MEET SOMEWHERE THAT IS NOT THIS YARD, AND THIS YARD IS NOT GOING TO BE THE ONE THAT MOVES THEM ALONG, AND IT IS ENTERED WITH NO FIGURE AGAINST IT.**
20. **A SLATE WENT DOWN AT SEVENTY FATHOMS ON THE TWELFTH WITH A LEAD OF ABOUT FOURTEEN POUNDS MARKED AT EVERY FATHOM AND NO NAME ON IT, because nobody signs anything in that yard and nobody has since the third of April past, and its entry is in the first column and is checkable by anybody with a lead and fourteen pounds in about nine minutes.** That is the first of the five elements of the volume's final chapter image and it is a thing that was done.

### 3. What did not move, and may not be moved

**THE CHANDLER'S NOTE AT THIRTY-ONE, NOT RE-WRITTEN, ITS THREE COUNTS OF WEEKS AT TWENTY-TWO AND THIRTEEN AND ELEVEN UNMOVED BY ARITHMETIC, AND IT WAS NOT SAID OUT LOUD A FIFTH TIME. THE DELAYED NOTE AT ELEVEN LOGGED OCCASIONS AND TWO OF THEM WITH NO CALL IN THEM, A HAND'S WIDTH OF A SECOND, NOTHING MEASURED, NO OCCASION ENTERED, AND THE ANSWER INSIDE IT NOT APPROACHED. THE NOTICE OF THE THIRTY-FIRST OF OCTOBER PAST WITH ITS FOUR CLAUSES, NOT LIFTED, NARROWED, RE-SERVED OR ALTERED, NO TENTH ACKNOWLEDGEMENT ENTERED AND NONE ASKED FOR, AND ITS SECOND CLAUSE BINDING ON THE ROUND OF GLASS, WHICH WAS PUT ON THE CROWN OF THAT MOLE AND NOT INTO ANY SHED ON THE SAID DAY AND IS NOT GOING INTO ANY SHED. FOUR RETURNS AND NO FIFTH, AND NO RETURN OF ANY KIND MADE OUT OF ANY OF THE TEN DAYS, AND NO FINDING OF WORKED GLASS MADE IN ANY OF THEM. THE PLATE IN ELEVEN FEET, NOT REACHED, NOT MEASURED, NOT TOUCHED, NOT ASKED ABOUT, NOTE OPEN FOR A THIRD VOLUME. THE CASE OF FIVE BELLS, NOT RAISED, NOT ASKED ABOUT, THE LIMIT FOUR PEOPLE OF THAT COAST WROTE AND SIGNED STANDS, AND THE HOLDER DID NOT ASK TO HAVE IT LIFTED ONCE IN THESE TEN DAYS. THE LEAD PLUG AND THE CHEST AND THE UNDERTAKING OF THE SECOND OF JULY; THE BELLWRIGHT WAS NOT ASKED IN ANY OF THESE TEN DAYS AND NO DIGIT OF ANYTHING HE SAID IS PRINTED. THE THIRD COLUMN, UNFILLED, UNAPPOINTED, THE BOY'S HAND AT THE HEAD OF IT, AND THE FOUR NAMELESS LINES ABOVE HIS NAMED LINE STILL FOUR, STILL NAMELESS, NOT STRUCK OUT, AND IN ABOUT SIXTY BOATS. THE FORTY MARKS TWICE, STANDING WHOLE AND FIRST AFTER FOOD, NEITHER REDUCED AND NEITHER PAID, AND THE FACT THAT THE FIGURE THE BAG IS SHORT OF THE WAGE OF FOUR MARKS CAME BACK WITH A SUBJECT IS NOT A REDUCTION OF EITHER. THE COMPARTMENT SPENT, THE THREE GANNET DOCUMENTS STILL THREE, THE MANIFEST'S DISCREPANCY UNUSED, THE COAST ROAD UNRESOLVED AND THE KETTLE NOT LOOKED AT, THE THREE FIGURES NOT SWAPPED, THE CUSTODY ROOM NOT ENTERED AND ITS THREE ITEMS NOT QUOTED TO A DIGIT. THE WRIT, THE CHARTER, THE FOUR-HUNDRED-YARD BAR, THE SEASON THAT ENDED ON THE THIRTY-FIRST OF MARCH WITH NOTHING ISSUED, AND THE SECOND BELL ELIGIBILITY, NOT RESTORED, NOT APPLIED FOR, NOT MOVED ONTO ANYTHING. THE CHAIN OF CUSTODY IS A JURISDICTION AND A PRACTICE AND IS NOT A REGISTRY AND IS NOT A COURT, WAS MADE ON THE SIXTH OF MARCH PAST, IS NOT AGED BY THIS, AND THIS YARD DID NOT LOOK IN ONE OF THE FOUR DRAWERS IT CANNOT LOOK IN AND WROTE TO NOBODY. NOTHING WAS PUT ON THE FAR BENCH AND READ AS A GIFT, AND ALDEN MARR DID NOT CONFESS, DID NOT WARM, WAS NOT ASKED ANYTHING, AND NO FRAGMENT, NO REPORT TALK AND NO SECOND STORY APPEARS ON ANY PAGE OF THE TEN.**

**AND THE REVEALS: THE WORD *QUIETENING* APPEARS NOWHERE IN CHAPTERS 291 TO 300 AND IS NOT NAMED AGAIN. THE OFFICE OF RETURNING MEMORY IS NOT NAMED. NO ONE OF THE NINE FINAL ROUTES IS NAMED IN THE PROSE. THE WORDS *CROWN SEAL* APPEAR IN CHAPTER 291 AND AFTER IT. NO SENIOR EXAMINER, NO MAGISTRATE AND NO OFFICER OF THE NAVY IS A FACE ON ANY PAGE OF THIS BATCH; HALVEN ROOK IS NOWHERE IN IT; CAPTAIN VEYRA HOLT IS NOWHERE; MAGISTER ILYA SERR IS A SEAL LINE ON TWO PAGES AND IS IN NO ROOM, ON NO MOLE, IN NO MARKET AND NOT IN THIS HARBOR, WAS NOT SENT FOR AND WAS NOT ASKED ANYTHING. NO OFFICE ANSWERS ANYTHING IN A ROOM, AND NO CLERK IN A COPYING ROOM EXPLAINS ANYTHING. NO ONE OF THE FOUR PEOPLE OF THAT COAST WAS ASKED FOR ANYTHING, THE COMPLAINT WAS NOT RAISED, AND THE FACT THAT THIS YARD HAS NOW READ THE SILL OF A CHAMBER OF THAT KIND AT SEVENTY FATHOMS IN ITS OWN GROUND IS NOT A REASON TO ASK THEM AND WAS NOT USED AS ONE. NO CHAPTER STATES WHO WANTED ANYTHING, AT WHOSE INSTANCE ANYTHING WAS DONE, OR WITH WHAT INTENT. THERE IS NO PANEL, STAT BLOCK, CHARACTER SHEET, STATUS MESSAGE, FLOATING TEXT, QUEST TEXT, SKILL TREE, LEVEL-UP OR SOFTWARE VOCABULARY, NO SECOND PERSON ADDRESSING THE READER, AND NOTHING ON ANY PAGE KNOWS ANYTHING.**

### 4. The power state, and the cost of the perception paid as a body and not as a stage

**NO STAGE IS TAKEN. THE FAULTREADER STAGE WAS TAKEN IN VOLUME 03, WAS SPENT, AND WAS NOT RE-TAKEN, NOT IMPROVED AND NOT RENAMED. THE BELLWRIGHT STAGE WAS TAKEN IN VOLUME 05 AND IS NOT IMPROVED, AND ITS SEASON OF NINE MARKS IS NOT PAID AND THE SEASON OF THE SECOND LAY'S MARK IS NINE MARKS AND IS NOT PAID EITHER. WHAT THIS BATCH PAID IS THE COST OF THE PERCEPTION IN ORDINARY WORK, ONCE, ON THE SIXTH OF MAY, IN THE SECOND COLUMN WITH A REASON AGAINST THE LINE AND NO NAME IN IT, being an afternoon on the crown of that mole lost to the body, and the afternoon carries no figure because there is no figure for a day, and the day's entry was then written by him in his own right hand, slowly, in about twenty minutes, and nobody helped him.** The condition is named nowhere in this batch. **What this batch also paid, separately, and NOT to the condition, is a permanent loss of a portion of that man's own recall, entered in the second column on the twelfth of May with a reason against the line and no name in it and no figure, and it is not a stage, and it is not the condition, and the condition's own line on the sixth of May is a different line with a different reason and the two are not to be read as one thing.** Nothing in these ten chapters settles an argument, proves a motive or tells anybody what happened: a strike on a link and a strike on a collar are both differences and neither of them is a truth, and they stand in the first column as things a man can go and look at and are not read as if they were.

### 5. The length rule, measured once and recorded

**27,571 WORDS ACROSS TEN CHAPTERS, AN AVERAGE OF 2,757, AGAINST 2,200–3,200 A CHAPTER: Ch291 3,571 · Ch292 2,782 · Ch293 2,368 · Ch294 2,279 · Ch295 2,286 · Ch296 2,233 · Ch297 2,651 · Ch298 2,415 · Ch299 2,983 · Ch300 4,003, MEASURED WITH `wc -w` INCLUDING HEADINGS, THESE BEING THE FIGURES AFTER THE REVIEW REPAIRS OF 28 SEPTEMBER 2026 RECORDED IN THE SECTION BELOW. EIGHT CHAPTERS ARE INSIDE THE GUIDELINE AND TWO ARE PAST IT.** The two that are past it are **Chapter 291 at three hundred and seventy-one words over, which ran past the guideline before this review as well, at sixty-three words, and which is further past it now because the review found the batch's only income resting on a question no page answered and required the private hire to be closed inside itself, and a finding and a price could not be added for nothing**, and **Chapter 300, the volume's close, at eight hundred and three over, which carries the read-back of the leaf, the thirteen things, the whole standing inventory once and the volume's final chapter image in all five of its elements; the outline's own shape note says that a close which reaches four thousand is a close which has begun saying the same figures twice, and a reviewer of this batch should read Chapter 300 against that sentence, because it is the one shape item in this batch that is past the guideline and it is not a fault of plot, of cost, of reveal or of calendar.** The whole standing inventory is carried in Chapter 300 and nowhere else, and the first-column and second-column entries in the other nine do dated work and do not restate the book. **THE FIGURES 27,706, 27,212, 2,771, 2,721, 3,259, 3,263, 2,766, 2,284, 2,292, 2,248, 2,242, 2,379, 2,604, 2,414, 2,990, 3,997 AND 4,527 ARE WITHDRAWN AND NAMED AS WITHDRAWN HERE AND AT `state/current.md` ITEM 12.** **NO PERCENTAGE OF APPARATUS IS QUOTED HERE. The Batch 0003 and Batch 0004 figures of 40.6% and 35.2% were measured on wider definitions that could not be re-derived, the re-measurement on the stated method gave 18.9% for Batch 0004, and `state/continuity.md` § *Batch 0004 as written* § 5 already rules that a percentage re-measured on a different definition is a different figure wearing the same name. No such figure is carried forward for this batch and none is invented.**
