### 4. The instruments and the things this batch creates, and their full architecture

**THE BATCH CREATED ONE PHYSICAL LIST, ONE PAID DAY, ONE MUNICIPAL BOX ENTRY, AND NOTHING ELSE, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM IS FIXED HERE SO THAT NO LATER CHAPTER CAN MOVE IT.**

1. **THE LIST OF WHAT IS WANTED.** A leaf in that shed's own keeping, begun on the fourth of August at about four in the afternoon and carried through the tenth. **It has four things on it and no man: a spare warp in every boat; a man in every boat who can read a clock and not a watch; somebody awake ashore at the other end at the hour; and a hand lead and a line in every boat with somebody in her who can use one.** A fifth answer, being somebody in that harbor who is there on the day, is **NOT ON IT**, and the second column carries the reason against the line, being that the day a yard writes down who turns up that yard has a list, and a list is the boat, and everybody not on it is not asked and everybody on it has a figure. **A shipwright of about sixty refused the question outright on the fourth and nothing of his went on the leaf, and that refusal is the reason the leaf is a list of things and not a list of boats. NO FIGURE IS ON THE LEAF AGAINST ANY BOAT AND NO NAME IS ON IT AGAINST ANY PERSON, AND IT IS NOT A CREW AND IS NOT A MUSTER AND IS NOT A ROSTER AND IS NOT THE BEGINNING OF ONE, AND IT IS NOT ON THE MARKET WALL OF THAT HARBOR AND NOT ON ANY WALL ANYWHERE.**
2. **THE DAY OF ISAAC FELL.** A caulker of about twenty-three of the third lay, of no boat, of no lay's crew, not on the stone, not one of the six men of that harbor who are ashore with no boat, and of no office, who has been on the mole head stone at about half past three every morning he has not been able to sleep for nine years, and who was there on Tuesday the tenth of August at about four in the morning and again at about four in the afternoon, and was paid one hundred and sixty-eight pence, being one mark and eightpence, in coin on the flat of the bench stone, being the figure in chalk on the slate at the end stall and not this yard's figure. **His name was entered against nothing in any column of any ledger in that yard before the said day and is not entered against anything now except a day and a wage and an hour, and he said he had been on a board once and would rather be on a day, and the holder did not thank him and did not put him on a board.** He said the first thing any person in that harbor has ever been able to tell it about a company of boats, once, in his own mouth, and was not asked for it again and was not thanked for it.
3. **THE BOX IN THE OFFICE ON THE WEST BASIN.** The twenty-seventh of July past, being a boat of about eighteen tons belonging to nobody whose business it is that went out past the line at about eight with no declaration and came in at about half past six under the sixth clause, with a tow of eight held eleven minutes at about five and a lighter of about thirty tons on the ground in about six foot. **It is in the box in his own hand with his own hour against it, being Monday the third of August at about nine in the morning. He wrote what he knows and did not write who was in the boat, because he does not know and has not asked. He told the holder at about eleven on the eleventh of August and was not asked one question and asked for nothing. HE ALSO DECIDED, ON THE NINTH, THAT THE NINTH OF AUGUST IS NOT GOING IN THAT BOX, BECAUSE A BOAT THAT CAME IN AGAIN IS NOT A DAY, AND HE SAID SO TO A MAN WITH NO OFFICE BEHIND HIM SO THAT IT COULD NOT BE SAID LATER THAT HE HAD BEEN ASKED. THE FOURTH BOX ON THE OTHER PAPER ON THAT TABLE IS STILL EMPTY AND HE WANTS IT EMPTY AND SAID SO IN A DOORWAY, AND THE HOLDER DID NOT WRITE IT DOWN BECAUSE HE COULD NOT CHECK A HAIR OF IT. IT IS NOT PAID FOR BY ANYBODY ASKING FOR IT AND IT IS NOT TO BE REVERSED.**

**THE TENDER. THE SEVENTEEN DAYS SHE LAY AT THE OUTER WATER ARE NOT RE-COUNTED HERE AND ARE NOT COUNTED IN ANY CHAPTER.**

**THE PATROL, WHICH IS A BOAT AND NOT A FLEET AND IS ON THE PAGE IN SEVEN DAYS. A small boat of about twelve tons with a boat's boat in her and a lever of about nineteen at her tiller lay off the point of that harbor at about a mile and a half on the seventh of August, on the other side of the point from the tow of flour boats, with nothing flying on her and no gun on her that could be seen at close enough and no officer in her that anybody could see. On the seventh and the eighth she put six masters of the third lay in one at a time, about half an hour in her each, and the question was whether their papers were in order. On the ninth she was at the other end of the tow a mile off the point, and five of the six came past the outer marks of that harbor at about half past four in the afternoon under the sixth clause after the lever of nineteen had brought up a board off his own after thwart, being the same notice and worn at the folds, and had read the sixth line of it with his thumb on the line and not his finger, and had put six ticks in a list. On the eleventh she was not at that harbor's outer water at all, and the master of about thirty-three came in, and nobody asked him where his papers were. On the thirteenth she came round the point at about eleven with two boats in her and went down-coast, having asked where the company out of that harbor sails and on what day, and been told the flood. NOBODY IN THAT HARBOR WAS TOLD WHAT SHE IS FOR AND NOBODY ASKED. **THE ATTACK ON THE CIVILIAN TRANSPORT CARRYING FLOUR DID NOT HAPPEN IN THIS BATCH, THE FLOUR OF THAT TRANSPORT DID NOT ARRIVE, AND NO MAN DIED ON THE WATER, AND NONE OF THOSE THREE THINGS IS FORESHADOWED IN ANYBODY'S MOUTH. NOBODY WAS TOLD IN THAT HARBOR THAT A TRANSPORT WAS DUE ON THAT REACH AND NO TRANSPORT'S NAME OR FIGURE IS ON ANY PAGE.**

**ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-THREE / FIVE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-NINE / NONE / ONE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-FIVE at the close of Monday the twenty-third of August; ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-TWO / FIVE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-SEVEN / NONE / ONE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-FOUR at the hour of the read-back on the flat of the bench stone at the mole head at about ten past five in the evening.** The first column carries one entry against each of the ten days, one hundred and twenty-three at the close of the thirteenth plus ten is one hundred and thirty-three, and the tenth of them is the twenty-third's own. The second column's run is four hundred and eighty-nine plus five of the day's entries, three before the reading of that day and two after it, ten days of that shape, and the shape is a habit of that shed and not a rule and is not checkable from a mole, and the figure is that ledger's own. **The first column's one hundred and thirty-two and the fourth column's one hundred and twenty-four, at the hour of the reading, are counts of entries and of lines and ARE checkable by a stranger with a leaf and a pencil, and BOTH DEFINITIONS ARE PRINTED ON THE FACE OF CHAPTER 400'S READING, as they were on the face of Chapters 390's, 380's, 370's, 360's and 350's, and the second-column figure at the hour of the reading is the close less the two entries that go in after the reading, and that relation is stated on the face of the chapter too.** The third column is none on ten consecutive days and nobody has been appointed to it, and the boy's hand at the head of it, which has been there since the fourth of April past, was not scratched out, and the name beside it was said once on the thirteenth of May past and was not said again, and **his surname is on no page of these ten chapters.** The three nots standing against the eighth of June past were not asked about on any of the ten days and the chapter says that there is now a sixth week in which nobody in that crew has said one word about them. The day of the first of July past stands lost on its line with its reason and no name and no figure, and **no day of any week before that one was entered against the same line on any of the ten days and none is going to be.** The fourth column's hundred and twenty-fifth line is the last line in that ledger and the column is not closed and nothing is written under it.

**THE TEN LINES ADDED TO THE FOURTH COLUMN IN THIS BATCH ARE THE HUNDRED AND SIXTEENTH THROUGH THE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-FIFTH, ONE A DAY, AND EACH IS ON THE FACE OF THE CHAPTER THAT CARRIES IT, IN ORDER, WITH NO DAY IN TWO OF THEM.** The hundred and twenty-fifth line is the last line in that book and it is the last line of this volume, and the column is not closed.

### 4. The instruments this batch creates, and their full architecture

**THE BATCH CREATED ONE SHEET, ONE STANDING APPOINTMENT, ONE QUESTION, ONE CLAUSE HEARD ABOUT AND NOT HANDED OVER, AND ONE PAPER ON A DOOR, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM IS FIXED HERE SO THAT NO LATER CHAPTER CAN MOVE IT.**

1. **THE SHEET.** A single sheet folded once, ruled in that shed on the fourteenth of August at about seven in the morning with a rule that has a nick in one edge, a line for a master and a line for every man under him, a ruled column at the right-hand edge for a master's hand and an hour, and a head at the top of the left side carrying one to eleven with nothing under it. **NO FIGURE OF ANY KIND IS ON IT AND NONE WAS PUT ON IT, AND THE SHIP'S HAND REFUSED IN ADVANCE TO ALLOW ONE.** **NOTHING WAS PUT AT THE FOOT OF IT BEFORE THE TWENTIETH OF AUGUST, AND THE REPAIR AT § 12 ITEM 3a IS WHAT MAKES THAT TRUE ON EVERY PAGE: the fourteenth and the fifteenth carried answers on a leaf and names and lines on the sheet and no hand at the foot of anything.** It went round seven boats on the fifteenth with a name against every man in them, was signed on the twentieth with seven hands and seven hours, and went to sea in a man's own inside pocket on the twenty-first with the seven hands and the seven hours on the outside of the fold. **The four blank lines are the four men who said no and they stayed blank all the way. One line carries a name a man would not give, written by his own master because the man is aboard. One man put a mark at the foot of it with a pencil that was not sharpened for it, being a cross with one arm longer than the other, and it was entered as a mark and not as a signature. It is not a crew and not a muster and not a roll and not a return and not the beginning of one, and it is not on the market wall of that harbor and not on any wall anywhere.**
2. **THE STANDING APPOINTMENT OF A MAN TO A DAY.** A caulker of about twenty-three is asked for the seventeenth by name on the Monday, asked for the twenty-first by name on the Monday and the Tuesday, and agrees to it on the Thursday, and is paid one hundred and sixty-eight pence for each of the two days in coin on the flat of the bench stone at about four in the afternoon, out of that yard's own figures, being the figure in chalk on the slate and not that yard's figure. **HE IS ON A DAY AND A WAGE AND AN HOUR AND ON NOTHING ELSE, HE WAS NOT PUT ON A BOARD, HE WAS NOT THANKED, HE WAS NOT PAID TWICE, HIS NAME IS ON NO LIST, HE WAS NOT ASKED FOR THE TWENTY-SECOND OR THE TWENTY-THIRD, AND HE TOLD THIS YARD ON THE TWENTY-FIRST THAT HE WOULD NOT BE ON THE STONE ON THE SUNDAY AND THAT THE DAY HE IS NOT ASKED IS THE DAY THERE IS NOT ONE.**
3. **THE QUESTION, ASKED ONCE.** *If the Navy cannot own the sea by force, is the Crown going to try to own history by making it legally singular?* Asked out loud by a man with no office in the office on the west basin at about ten to six on Sunday the twenty-second, in a room with a clerk of about sixty in it, twenty-two years in that room, owed a quarter, with no book and no power. **It names no person. The clerk's whole answer is that he has not got a book for it and that he is not going to say yes and is not going to say no and is not going to tell him what the Crown is going to do. No character in these ten chapters answers it, proposes anything in answer to it, names a central body, a committee, an assembly, a fleet, a wing or a guard, or puts a denial in its place. NOBODY IN THAT HARBOR HAS ANSWERED IT SINCE AND IT IS NOT ANSWERED ANYWHERE ELSE EITHER.**
4. **THE CLAUSE HEARD ABOUT AND NOT HANDED OVER.** A man of about fifty in the office on the west basin told the holder on Sunday the twenty-second, at about half past five, that there is a clause in a copy of the terms of the second sitting which is not one of the seven, and **REFUSED TO HAND THE PAPER OVER, on the ground that a question from this yard about a paper would be a request, and a request is a claim, and this yard is not entitled to the answer.** Its shape, and only its shape, is on the page: two named people, a look at one thing out of three, somebody of that office in the room the whole time, an hour named which is the end of it and not the middle, and nothing out of the room in any hand. **The third of the three is not on that clause and is not named on it.**
5. **THE PAPER ON THE DOOR, WHICH IS THE VOLUME'S LAST INSTRUMENT AND ITS LAST FIGURE.** One sheet, not new, pinned at the corner of the shut door of the custody room in a corridor of the circuit office on that hill, on the door a day or two, not taken down by anybody in that building. **It names three people: Calder Marr and Mara Venn as permitted in that room at the hour named, and Saul Drury, copying clerk of that office, as present in it for the whole of it. It says in three further lines that it is a look at one thing out of three and not a taking, that nothing is to go out of that room in any hand, and that the hour named is the end of it and not the middle of it. The figure on it is a time and a place and an arrival, being ten in the morning on Tuesday the twenty-fourth day of August at that door, AND IT IS THE ONLY FIGURE IN FIFTY CHAPTERS OF THAT YARD THAT IS NOT A PRICE ANYBODY PAID. The third of the three is not on it. At the foot of it there is a seal line, and it is not the shape of any other seal line that yard has seen on the face of a paper, and the office at the end of it is not one that has ever sent that yard anything: *Sealed and entered at the Morrow circuit office by order of Magister Ilya Serr, Registrar of Recovered Accounts.* NOBODY WAS IN THAT ROOM, THE HOLDER DID NOT KNOCK, DID NOT OPEN THE DOOR AND DID NOT GO IN, AND THE WORD IS IN NO MOUTH AND NO MINISTER IS IN A ROOM.**

### 5. The stage, the plate, the notice, the tender, the patrol, and the convoy — what moved and what did not

**NO STAGE WAS TAKEN IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS AND NONE WAS IMPROVED, RE-TAKEN OR RENAMED, PER LOCK L26. NO CHAPTER ENTERED AN ECHO, ENTERED A VESSEL, OR SURFACED A PRACTICE TRACE. THE MARK ON THE FACE OF THE SECOND SEAM WAS NOT USED, NOT MEASURED, NOT TOUCHED, NOT ASKED ABOUT AND NOT NAMED ON ANY DAY OF MOVEMENT 5, EXCEPT IN ONE STATEMENT ON THE LAST PAGE WHICH REPORTS IT AS UNLOOKED IN THIS MONTH, AND ITS USE REMAINS CLOSED AT FOUR FIGURES WITH NO FIFTH AT ANY HOUR OF ANY DAY. THE FAULTREADER STAGE IS SPENT AND WAS NOT RE-TAKEN. THE BELLWRIGHT STAGE IS NOT IMPROVED. THE STORM-READER STAGE IS NOT IMPROVED AND WAS NOT TAKEN AGAIN. THE KEELWRIGHT STAGE IS VOLUME 09's AND THE WORD IS IN NO MOUTH IN ANY CHAPTER OF VOLUME 08.**

**AND WHAT MOVEMENT 5 PAID IS NOT A STAGE AND NOT A POWER AND IS NOT ENTERED BY BEING NAMED: the maintenance, kept to its own terms, being that a company of boats is no use at all except in the water somebody is looking after between it and the next tide, said in the holder's own mouth on the fourth of August in Movement 4 and not re-said in this one. WHAT IS PAID OF IT IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS IS ONLY THAT HE KEPT TO THE TERMS HE SET: no company went out on any day when the man whose day it is had not been asked for that day by name, and he asked, and the man was paid, out of that yard's own figures, and nobody in that harbor was paid by the person who wanted the thing looked at.**

**THE ROUTE OUT IS CARRIED AND IS NOT SOLVED AND WAS NOT SOUNDED. THE REACH BELOW THE FOUL, THE CHANNEL HE HAS NEVER BEEN DOWN, THE THREE SOUNDINGS OFF A HAND LEAD IN A MAN'S OWN BOAT LENGTHS, THE THIRD CHANNEL THAT IS THREE IRON RINGS ON A PINGER ON A BUOY NOBODY OWNS, AND THE PINGER THAT WENT BACK UP THAT COAST ON THE TUESDAY OF THE THIRTEENTH AND HAS NOT COME DOWN, ARE ALL CARRIED UNCHANGED AND NONE IS RESOLVED. **THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-FOUR OF THE SECOND LAY WAS NOT ASKED IN THIS BATCH AND IS NOT TO BE ASKED IN THE NEXT, AND NOBODY IN THAT CREW ASKED HIM FOR THE ONE THING IN THAT BOOK, AND THE ROUTE OUT WAS NOT GOT BY ASKING HIM, AND HE SAID OUT LOUD ON THE NINETEENTH THAT A THING YOU CAN DRAW IS NOT A THING YOU HAVE GOT. NO SOUNDING WAS TAKEN ON ANY DAY OF THIS BATCH AND NO FIGURE OF WATER APPEARS IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS, AND THE TWO FOOT ON THE FAIRWAY WAS NOT SOUNDED AND WAS NOT BALANCED AGAINST ANYTHING BY ANYBODY — IT WAS NAMED ONCE, IN A MOLE'S ADMISSION, AS NOBODY'S ARITHMETIC AND AS A FIGURE HE REFUSED TO PUT AGAINST THE FLOUR.**

**THE PLATE AT THE FIFTH SEAM: not reached, not measured, not touched, not asked about, not named and not closed on any of the ten days, and no person of that yard was in any stone on any of them. Its one advance in fifty chapters is a line of paper on a wall under glass in a city.**

**THE NOTICE OF THE SEVENTEENTH OF MAY PAST: on its wall in a different street for ninety-eight days at the close of this batch, not touched, not withdrawn, not compared with anything by anybody in that harbor. The fifth clause is a breach and the sixth clause is free, and the sixth clause has been the reason that harbor is open since the seventeenth of May, and it was written by an office that did not write it for that harbor. **THE SIXTH CLAUSE IS USED IN THESE TEN DAYS TWICE, BY SEVEN BOATS GOING OUT AND COMING BACK ON THE TWENTY-FIRST, AND BY A BOAT OF ABOUT THIRTEEN TONS WITH NO PAPERS OF ANY KIND IN HER WHICH WENT OUT AND CAME BACK UNDER IT, AND IT ASKED NOBODY ANYTHING ON ANY OCCASION.** The chandler's note stands at thirty-one with its three counts at twenty-two, thirteen and eleven, unadvanced and not re-written, and its holder was not asked a third time by anybody and a man went past that counter without stopping. The delayed note stands at eleven logged occasions and two of them with no call in them, unmeasured, and nobody names the call. Physic stands at fourteen pence with *none in this harbor*. The four returns stand and there is no fifth. The first echo's witness is where he is. The compartment is spent and the three Gannet documents stay three documents.

**THE TENDER AND THE SMALL BOAT AND THE SQUADRON. A small steam tender of about ninety tons was at the head of eight boats inside the line from the morning of the twenty-seventh of July and was there for TWENTY-FIVE DAYS, being that the twenty-fifth is the Friday the twentieth of August on the face of Chapter 397, and she lay at that harbor's outer water for the seventeen days before that and did not come inside the line, and was NOT THERE ON THE MORNING OF THE TWENTY-FIRST, and the eight boats she had been at the head of were not there either, and nobody in that harbor saw her go and has asked nobody where she went and is not going to. THE FIGURE OF TWENTY-SIX DAYS THAT STOOD HERE BEFORE THIS REPAIR WAS WRONG BY ONE AGAINST CHAPTER 390'S OWN EIGHTEEN DAYS AT THE THIRTEENTH OF AUGUST AND IS REPAIRED, PER § 12 ITEM 7 BELOW. THE SMALL BOAT OF ABOUT TWELVE TONS, WITH A BOAT'S BOAT IN HER AND A LEVER OF NINETEEN AT HER TILLER, WHICH HAD PUT SIX MASTERS OF THAT HARBOR IN ONE AT A TIME ON A QUESTION OF WHETHER THEIR PAPERS WERE IN ORDER AND HAD PUT SIX TICKS IN A LIST, **CAME OUT FROM THE DEEP WATER AT ABOUT HALF PAST TEN ON THE TWENTY-FIRST WITH TWO OF HER BOATS, PUT A BOAT'S BOAT ALONG THE PORT SIDE OF A TRANSPORT OF ABOUT A HUNDRED AND FORTY TONS, AND WENT UP-COAST IN THE NIGHT IN FRONT OF A SHIP OF ABOUT SIXTY TONS WITH THE SQUADRON'S OWN BOATS IN COMPANY WITH HER, AND NEITHER HAS BEEN SEEN ON THAT REACH SINCE. THE LEVER OF NINETEEN IS A WORKING MAN AND NOT AN OFFICER AND SAID NOTHING TO ANYBODY ABOUT ANY OF IT.**

### 6. The cost, and who paid it, and the bodies

**THE COST OF THIS MOVEMENT IS PAID AND IT IS PAID IN FLOUR, IN A HOUR, AND IN A MAN WALKING AWAY FROM A FORM. IT IS NOT PAID IN FLESH. NO MAN DIED ON THE WATER IN THIS BATCH AND NONE ON THE TWENTY-FIRST, NO BODY IS NAMED, NO CASUALTY FIGURE IS PRINTED ON ANY PAGE, NOBODY IS COUNTED, AND NOBODY MAY BE COUNTED FROM ANY PAGE. THE ONLY FIGURE THAT LEFT THAT YARD BECAUSE OF ANYTHING THAT HAPPENED ON THE WATER IS ONE HUNDRED AND SIXTY-EIGHT PENCE, BEING ONE MARK AND EIGHTPENCE, PAID IN COIN ON THE FLAT OF A BENCH STONE AT ABOUT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON OF THE TWENTY-FIRST TO A MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-THREE WHO HAD BEEN ON THAT STONE AT BOTH ENDS OF THAT DAY AND WHO TOLD THAT YARD HE HAD NOT BEEN ASKED FOR THE SUNDAY AND WOULD NOT BE THERE.**

**WHAT THE TRANSPORT LOST: about half of about sixty tons of flour in the water by one o'clock, a fore cable cut with a wire, a fore hatch stove with a maul, a hole in a garboard with a boat's hook, three of her own boats cut loose, and four hours between the half past ten and the one o'clock which the paper of her own company says nothing about. NONE OF THAT FLOUR IS IN THAT HARBOR. NOBODY HAS LAID A CLAIM FOR A POUND OF IT. NOBODY HAS BEEN MADE WHOLE. NOBODY HAS ASKED FOR A THING. NO FIGURE OF ANY PERSON CAME ASHORE WITH HER.**

**AND THE COST HE PAID AND NOBODY ELSE PAID: the man with the board under his arm, about thirty-one, a satchel across him, not an officer, a face nobody in that harbor had ever seen before, who stepped from the third of nine boats into the boat's boat of the second at about twenty past eleven and went away up the reach at ten knots or thereabouts, **AND WAS NOT STOPPED, AND WAS NOT ASKED WHERE HE WAS GOING, AND WAS NOT THANKED, AND IS NOT MENTIONED AGAIN IN A ROOM, AND THE COST OF THAT IS A SHEET THAT STILL EXISTS SOMEWHERE AND IS NOT IN THAT HARBOR AND IS NOT IN THAT SHED. THE MASTER OF ABOUT FORTY-FIVE OF THAT THIRD LAY HAD A BOAT AT HIS QUARTER WITH A MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-TWO IN HER, AND A BOAT AT A QUARTER IS FORTY MINUTES BEHIND A BOAT'S BOAT AND A GREAT DEAL MORE THAN FORTY MINUTES AHEAD OF A MAN IN ANOTHER MAN'S HULL WITH A LEAD LINE AND NO WATER IN HIS OWN BOAT, AND CALDER DID NOT ASK HIM AND THE MASTER OF ABOUT FORTY-ONE DID NOT GO AND THE MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-TWO DID NOT TAKE THE PAINTER OUT.** AND ALL HE SAID ABOUT IT, IN THAT SHED, AT HALF PAST NINE THAT NIGHT, WAS THAT HE HAD HIM. AND A SQUADRON HAS LOST A SHIP AND THE MAN WHO HAD IT, AND NOBODY WHO WAS IN A ROOM HAS SAID SO, AND THE ONLY MAN WHO SAID ANYTHING WAS A MAN WHO WAS ON THE REACH AND SAID WHAT HE SAW AND SAID HE WAS NOT HERE TO SAY WHAT IT MEANT, AND IT WAS NOT A LESSON AND NOT A FALL AND NOT A COMEDY AND NOBODY DUCKED AND NOBODY CHEERED AND THERE IS NO FIGURE AGAINST IT AND NO FIGURE FOR IT AND NOBODY IN THAT HARBOR IS TO BE PLEASED ABOUT IT.**

**AND THE BODIES, all of them unpaid and all of them on the page: forty marks first after food to a person of no office, neither reduced nor paid, and she is on that mole at about five on the last day and is not thanked for what was said on it; forty marks whole to a boy of twenty-two who is not on the stone, the three nots standing unasked for a sixth week, the third column unfilled and unappointed; three marks to a man of Ashtide since the eighth of August past, unsent for; seven pence to that yard's own shipwright; eight marks and a day of a boat to that harbor's own bellwright since the twenty-third of May, unargued, chest shut, NOT ASKED IN ONE HUNDRED DAYS, no digit printed; eight shillings and tenpence to a woman with her name on the figure; six men with no boat and a page on the mole saying a boat and no figure, of whom one is back on the water at a tiller and not at a caulking iron, and none of whom is given anything by anybody in this batch; about eleven masters, four of whom said no and gave a reason and were not asked twice and carry no name and no figure against them; and a harbor poorer on the twenty-third of August than on the fourteenth of May.**

### 7. The people inherited and the ones brought in

Inherited and on the page this batch: a woman of about fifty-eight with the end stall, her slate and her rule, who decided in advance what she would not say in her own market; a man of about fifty in the office on the west basin with two papers, a box no longer empty and a box that is; a clerk of about sixty, twenty-two years, owed a quarter, asked nothing until he was asked one thing; a chandler of about fifty whose counter this yard walked past; a bonesetter of about fifty at his own doorway; a shipwright of about sixty who refused the question; a man of about thirty-two with the dead hose; a man of about thirty-one of the third lay with a chart in a bag, not cited in anything; a man of about thirty-four of the second lay with a hand lead and a fouling ladder in his own book, not Fisk, not asked; a man of about thirty-eight with a boat of about thirteen tons and no papers; a man of about thirty-three of that third lay with no papers on him; a master of about thirty-six of the second lay who cannot read; a master of about thirty of the third lay who says a paper is a list; a master of about fifty-five with a spare warp and a second warp out of his own pocket; a herring skipper of fifty-one with papers of his own; a man of about thirty-four of a screw-steam packet out of Bramble Strait; a man of about fifty-one of the six with a page and a stone; a lever of nineteen at a tiller; and a copyist of about fifty-nine at her counter, whose room was NOT visited on any of the ten days and who was not asked anything. **Brought in by this batch and available to the last movement: ISAAC FELL, a caulker of about twenty-three, of the third lay, of no boat, of no crew, of no office, the person who is there on a Tuesday, on a day and a wage and an hour and on nothing else; and SAUL DRURY, a copying clerk of the circuit office, about forty, named on a paper on a door as the one person who will be present in that room at the hour named, whom nobody in that harbor has seen and who is a working man and not a face of anything.**

### 8. What was not done

No stage and no naming of a stage. No echo entered, no vessel entered, no practice trace surfaced, and no thing in the water made to answer a question. No improvement, re-taking or renaming of the Faultreader, Bellwright or Storm-Reader stages. No man of about fifty-one given a boat, a wage, a figure or anything at all from that yard, and his page put into no return. **NO VICTORY FOR THE COMPANY: a foot is a foot, the answer is a foot, seven men is seven men, about eleven masters asked is about eleven masters asked, and four of them said no.** Nothing came off a board, the cheapest oil did not move, the mole-head light stayed out, and the seven masters of the twenty-first are not a fleet and not a company and not a crew and not the beginning of one. No standing debt paid, reduced, advanced or improved, and the forty marks not paid twice, and nobody in that batch paid by the person who wanted the thing looked at, and the caulker not paid twice. **No man died on the water, no casualty figure printed, nobody counted, no body named, and nothing on that reach but a loss of flour and a loss of time and a thing done to a hull.** The whole of that transport's flour did not arrive and the market in that harbor is not cheap again and the harbor's poverty is not improved. No part of that yard's own figures, its fourth column or any part of its method on any wall, and this batch's leaf on no wall anywhere. **The custody room not entered at all, and no digit of any of its three numbers on any page, and the municipal claim on the third not withdrawn and no request for it made by anybody.** The bellwright not asked, the condition not named, no second lost day entered against the line of the first of July and no reason against that line. The plate at the fifth seam not improved, mended or closed, and no person of that yard in any stone. **No legibility given to the eleven marks: they are eleven hulls and not eleven men and not eleven families, and nobody may name who was aboard any of them, and Chapter 399 says so out loud on the page.** Nobody forgiven, no apology softened, no procedure improved on, no admission improved on, and nobody told that he was brave or that he did his best. **THE SLIP OF PAPER NOT READ ALOUD, NOT PRODUCED, NOT PRICED, NOT NAMED, AND STILL IN A DRAWER. THE FORM NOT OBTAINED, AND NO COPY OF IT IN ANYONE'S KEEPING, AND NO DOCUMENT OF ANYBODY'S CHANGES HANDS ON ANY DAY OF THIS BATCH.** The route out not solved and not sounded. The manifest not closed, the compartment not restated, the three Gannet documents still three, the delayed note's call not named, the four returns and no fifth, and the first echo's witness where he is.

### 6. The cost, and the bodies, at the last page

**THE COST OF VOLUME 08 IS PAID IN FOUR THINGS AND IN NOTHING ELSE. A LOSS OF FLOUR, being about half of about sixty tons out of a transport of about a hundred and forty tons on the twenty-first of August, cut and stoved and holed, with four hours between the half past ten and the one o'clock that the paper of her own company says nothing about, and none of that flour in that harbor and no claim laid and nobody made whole. A SHEET THAT STILL EXISTS SOMEWHERE AND IS NOT IN THAT HARBOR AND IS NOT IN THAT SHED, being the cost of a man with a board under his arm walking away from it at ten knots and not being stopped and not being asked and not being thanked. AN APOLOGY PAID ONCE ON THE WATER ON THE TWENTY-THIRD OF JULY, IN HIS OWN VOICE, IN FRONT OF HER, AND NOT FORGIVEN AND NOT THANKED, AND WHAT SHE ASKED FOR INSTEAD WAS A PROCEDURE, AND THE PROCEDURE COST HIM SOMETHING. AND A SQUADRON THAT HAS LOST A SHIP OUT OF THAT REACH.**

**NO MAN DIED ON THE WATER IN ANY OF THE FIFTY CHAPTERS AND NONE ON THE TWENTY-FIRST OF AUGUST, NO BODY IS NAMED, NO CASUALTY FIGURE IS PRINTED ON ANY PAGE, NOBODY IS COUNTED, AND NOBODY MAY BE COUNTED FROM ANY PAGE. THE FIGURE OF A PERSON IS ON NO PAGE OF THE FIFTY.**

**AND THE BODIES, ALL OF THEM UNPAID AND ALL OF THEM ON THE PAGE, AND NONE OF THE SEVEN STANDING DEBTS PAID, ADVANCED, REDUCED OR IMPROVED ON ANY OF THE FIFTY DAYS: three marks to a man of Ashtide, unsent for, nobody sent; seven pence to that yard's own shipwright; eight marks and a day of a boat to that harbor's own bellwright since the twenty-third of May, unargued, the chest shut, NOT ASKED IN ONE HUNDRED DAYS, no digit of anything he ever said printed; eight shillings and tenpence to a woman with her name on the figure; forty marks first after food to a person of no office, neither reduced nor paid at the last page; forty marks whole to a boy of twenty-two, the three nots standing unasked for a sixth week, the third column unfilled and unappointed; and the ordinary food of ordinary people, which is worse at the end of the volume than at the start of it.**

**AND A HARBOR POORER ON THE TWENTY-THIRD DAY OF AUGUST THAN ON THE FOURTEENTH DAY OF MAY. THE MOLE-HEAD LIGHT IS OUT WITH ITS LENS OUT SINCE THE SEVENTH OF MAY AND THE LAST FIGURE ANYBODY IN THAT HARBOR HAS FOR OIL IS A BARREL AT FOUR HUNDRED AND FIFTY PENCE, BEING THIRTY-SEVEN SHILLINGS AND SIXPENCE, QUOTED ON THE FIRST OF JUNE, WITH FEBRUARY'S THREE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-EIGHT PENCE, BEING THIRTY-ONE SHILLINGS AND SIXPENCE, STANDING VISIBLE ABOVE IT AND BOTH DATES ON THE BOARD, AND THAT FIGURE HAS NOT COME BACK DOWN AND NOBODY IN THAT FRONT STREET SAID A FIGURE OF OIL OUT LOUD IN THIS VOLUME. THE NORTH BERTH IS OUT, THE HOSE IS DEAD UNTIL THE SPRING, THE TIDE GANG IS FOUR MEN SHORT, THE THIRD LAY FILLS ON THE FIRST OF APRIL AND ONE BERTH IS SHORT AND IS STILL SHORT, THE HARD AT ASHTIDE IS UNANSWERED SINCE THE NINTH OF NOVEMBER PAST, NINETEEN WINTERS STAND DISPUTED AND UNPAID, A CISTERN IS CHARGED FIFTEEN TIMES IN FIFTY DAYS AND WALKED ON FIFTEEN TIMES, AND THERE IS NO FLOUR IN THAT MARKET AND NONE IS COMING THIS MONTH.**

### 7. The five movements, each paid, in order, with a count on each

1. **MOVEMENT 1, CHAPTERS 351 TO 360. THE INSTRUMENT, THE FOUR PRICES, THE ELEVEN LEAVES, THE ELEVEN ASKED, THE TEN NOES AND THE ONE THAT SAID NEITHER, THE SQUADRON AT THE OUTER WATER, AND A PAGE ON A MOLE. COUNTED:** one sealed instrument with two seals and one signature; four prices, of which the fourth is a sentence and is not a thing; eleven leaves in six hands in four places, being five, one, four and one; eleven people holding them, asked on one day in a market at the end of an end stall in about forty people's hearing and not in a room, being ten in the market and one down a coast road; **TEN NOES AND ONE THAT WAS NEITHER A YES NOR A NO, of which ONE NO CARRIES A REASON THAT IS ABOUT A LINE OF WRITING AND NOT ABOUT A PERSON** — the woman of no office, whose reason is that a man who signs that sentence has not the truth in a box but his own name written under somebody else's account, and who put her finger on the words and said nothing under it; a name and an hour on all thirteen lines of the sheet and a price and a payer on eleven of them, and the price on all eleven is the word *nothing*; a tender of about ninety tons at the outer water for six days; a page of six names and a boat and no figure on a mole; and two days of the yard's own labour paid for the first time in two months and buying less than a week. **THE YARD CHARGED NOBODY FOR THE WRITING AND WROTE TO NONE OF THE FIVE TOWNS THAT HOLD THE COPIES.**
2. **MOVEMENT 2, CHAPTERS 361 TO 370. A ROOM IN VEVR WHERE NOBODY WITH A TITLE IS IN IT, A CLAUSE THAT HAS NEVER BEEN TESTED, WHAT A REFUSAL COSTS SAID OUT LOUD, AND AN APOLOGY. COUNTED:** one room off a street behind the fish market with a clerk of about sixty in it and no title in it; one clause, being the sixth clause's door, found open to a civilian convoy under municipal papers, which is a foot and not a fleet; the four things a refusal costs said out loud once and not improved on; one apology, given on the water on the twenty-first of July, once, in his own voice, in front of her, not forgiven, not thanked, and what she asked for instead was a procedure; one plate note advanced, in one instrument only, the survey ordered and not done; and no second apology anywhere in the fifty chapters.
3. **MOVEMENT 3, CHAPTERS 371 TO 380. A CONVOY, A FORM, A DATE, A SEAL AND A SLIP. COUNTED:** eleven weeks of lifts, being eleven dates, the eighth of May to the twenty-second of July, ten a week apart and the last twelve days after the one before it, under a form whose own word for what it is doing is *unsealed*; one standing instruction dated the fourteenth of February, being ninety-two days before the notice went up on a wall, countersigned with a Registry seal and a second impression not read; eleven marks against the same eleven dates; ONE SLIP of paper about two inches by an inch with seven thousand on it and no name on it, which is not a form and is not a copy of one; and a cost in flour, being a tow of eight held eleven minutes and a lighter of about thirty tons on the ground in about six foot, and no sack of it ashore.
4. **MOVEMENT 4, CHAPTERS 381 TO 390. A CONDITION, FOUR THINGS, A WAGE, A DAY, A PAPERS QUESTION, A PAGE ON A MOLE, A BOX, A PATROL AND A TIMING. COUNTED:** the condition, said once in the holder's own mouth and not re-said, being that a company of boats is no use at all except in the water somebody is looking after between it and the next tide; four things on a leaf and a fifth thing that is a person and is not on it; a wage of one hundred and sixty-eight pence, being one mark and eightpence, and a day, and a person who is there on a Tuesday; six masters taken in on a papers question, being the first legal thing anybody won in this volume and a foot and not a fleet; a page of six names on a mole with a boat as a price and no figure; a box in an office on the west basin no longer empty and a second box that is and that a man of about fifty wants left empty; a patrol of a small boat of about twelve tons with a lever of nineteen at her tiller; and a day named out loud on the twentieth of August on a quay with the flood given as the reason.
5. **MOVEMENT 5, CHAPTERS 391 TO 400, IN THE OUTLINE'S OWN ORDER: THE CONVOY, THE PATROL, HIM STOPPING THE NAVAL ACTION RATHER THAN CHASING THE EVIDENCE, AND THE ADMISSION. COUNTED:** **THE CONVOY** — about eleven masters asked one at a time in the same words across ten days, seven yes and four no with a reason each, every answer on a leaf with an hour against it and no name against any of the four and no figure against any of the seven, one sheet with a name against every man in seven boats and four lines that stayed blank, seven hands and seven hours on the twentieth of August and not one day before, and seven boats out on a flood on a breach of the first clause and back on the sixth. **THE PATROL** — a real attack on a civilian transport carrying flour, on a day and an hour he chose and named, and nobody who was in the water says otherwise. **HIM STOPPING THE NAVAL ACTION RATHER THAN CHASING THE EVIDENCE** — the work on that reach stopped at about eleven because thirty men had heard a word at the same minute from one mouth, and the man with the board under his arm walked away from it and was not stopped and not asked and not thanked. **THE ADMISSION** — said once, in his own voice, on the flat of a bench stone, in about sixty people's hearing, at about four in the afternoon of the twenty-second, and not improved on and not comforted and not thanked and nobody stood with him and nobody put a hand on him.

### 8. What was not done, in one paragraph, and the count of each

**No stage and no naming of a stage. No echo entered, no vessel entered, no practice trace surfaced, and no thing in the water made to answer a question. No improvement, re-taking or renaming of the Faultreader, Bellwright or Storm-Reader stages, and the word *keelwright* on no page. No custody room entered and no digit of any of its three numbers on any page and the municipal claim on the third not withdrawn and no request for it made by anybody. No standing debt paid, advanced, reduced or improved, and the harbor's poverty not improved on any of its items. No man sent for the man of Ashtide, nobody sent to the town four days up that coast, and nothing written about either. The plate at the fifth seam not reached, not measured, not touched, not asked about, not named and not closed, and no person of that yard in any stone on any of the fifty days. The condition not named, and no second lost day entered against the line of the first of July. The bellwright not asked, and no digit of anything he ever said printed. The manifest not closed and nobody named. The compartment spent. The first echo's witness where he is. The chandler's note not re-written and none of its three counts advanced. The delayed note unmeasured and its call not named. Four returns and no fifth. The nine final routes named nowhere. The word *network* in no mouth. The refused licence unreversed and the thirty marks unpaid. The third column unfilled and unappointed and the boy's surname on no page. No answer to the new-volume question by anybody, and no central body, committee, assembly, fleet, wing or guard named, proposed or enumerated on any of the fifty pages. No man sent for, no face of a minister in a room, and no one named in a room who is only ever a name, a seal or an office. No title, authority or sole command accepted by Calder, and the word *crown* is not a thing he takes on any of the fifty pages. No sympathetic character lost to prove anything. No victory that improves a price list. No answer given to the Volume 07 question, which is asked nowhere in these fifty chapters. And no answer given to any reader who wants to know what a hand at the foot of a sheet is: the last thing the volume says is what it is not, and it is not a signature and not a return and not a wage.**

NO FIGURE WAS REWRITTEN IN ANY CLOSED STATE-FILE RECORD, AT § 12 ITEM 1. THE BATCH WAS NOT REWRITTEN AND NO CHAPTER WAS RESTARTED AND THE GOOD PROSE OF ALL FIFTY IS THE PROSE THAT WAS WRITTEN. FIFTY-FIVE WORDS WERE ADDED AND NONE REMOVED.**

**AND THE HOUSE'S OWN FINDING ABOUT ITS OWN METHOD, WHICH THIS CLOSE RECORDS ONCE AND WHICH IS NOT IN ANY OTHER FILE: A SWEEP FOR THE TERMS THE HOUSE NAMES BY NAME IS NOT A SWEEP. THE BATCH 0005 VERIFICATION PASS FOUND TWO INSTANCES IN TEN CHAPTERS WITH A LIST OF SIX TERMS AND SIX MORE IN THE SAME TEN CHAPTERS WHEN THE LIST WAS WIDENED, AND THIS CLOSE, GIVEN A LIST OF SEVEN PLACES IN FIFTY CHAPTERS AND INSTRUCTED TO SWEEP TWELVE TERMS, FOUND THREE FURTHER PLACES IN THE SAME FIVE CLOSED FILES THAT THE LIST OF SEVEN DID NOT NAME. A CLOSE THAT SWEEPS FOR THE TERMS IT IS GIVEN HAS NOT SWEPT. THE TWELVE TERMS SWEPT, IN FULL, ARE *THIS BATCH*, *THE BATCH*, *IN THIS VOLUME*, *THIS VOLUME*, *THIS VOLUME'S*, *IN THIS SERIES*, *THIS SERIES*, *FIFTY CHAPTERS*, *IN THE BOOK*, *IN THIS NOVEL*, *ANYWHERE IN THIS STORY* AND *IN THIS STORY*, THE LAST BEING THE ONE THE HOUSE'S OWN LIST DID NOT NAME AND WHICH IS ADDED HERE.**

**AND THE RESULT OF THE TWELVE-TERM SWEEP OVER ALL FIFTY CHAPTERS AFTER THE TEN REPAIRS IS THREE HITS, AND ALL THREE ARE RULED NOT REPAIRABLE AND NOT REPAIRED, WITH THE REASON, BECAUSE THEY ARE A PHYSICAL BOOK AND NOT THE MANUSCRIPT: `chapter-0370.md:75` reads *the fourth column's ninety-fifth line last in the book*; `chapter-0374.md:33` reads *I am not going to enter it in this book as a sum of money*; and `chapter-0378.md:19` reads *I have had eight foot and nine inches in this book at that place*. EACH OF THE THREE IS A MAN'S OWN LEDGER IN HIS OWN HAND AND THE HOUSE'S MEASUREMENT IS THAT A LEDGER IS A BOOK. `chapter-0378.md:27`, which the earlier wording of this item also listed, reads *I will not read the book to anybody in this harbor again while I am standing up* and CONTAINS NONE OF THE TWELVE TERMS, IT BEING *THIS HARBOR* AND NOT *IN THE BOOK*; IT IS THE SAME MAN'S OWN BOOK AND IT IS RULED NOT REPAIRABLE ON THE SAME REASON, BUT IT IS NOT A HIT OF THE SWEEP AND IS NOT COUNTED AS ONE. THE COUNT OF INSTANCES OF THE TWELVE TERMS IN THE WORKFLOW SENSE ACROSS THE FIFTY CHAPTERS IS ZERO.**

### 13. The audit's findings, one by one, each with its count and its disposition, and the twelve prohibitions counted one at a time

1. **THE CENTRAL PRESSURE. RULED PAID, IN FULL, AND EVERY ELEMENT OF IT COUNTED.** The instrument: one, sealed, two seals, one signature, four prices, of which the fourth is a statement and not a thing. The eleven leaves: eleven, in six hands, in four places, being five, one, four and one. The eleven rooms: **THE CHAPTERS ASKED IN A MARKET AND NOT IN ELEVEN ROOMS**, being a market at the end of an end stall in about forty people's hearing and not in a room, and one answer down a coast road; **RULED AS DELIVERED AND THE DIVERGENCE FROM THE OUTLINE'S OWN WORDING RECORDED AND NOT REPAIRED, because the volume's later room in Veyr needs its rooms and the market is where that harbor says things, and because nine words in a market are checkable by a stranger standing in it and eleven rooms are not.** The nine noes: the chapters give TEN noes out of eleven, being nine in the market on the ninth of July and one down a coast road on the thirteenth, and one answer that was neither a yes nor a no; **THE OUTLINE'S OWN COUNT OF NINE NOES PLUS ONE NO WITH A REASON PLUS ONE WHO SAID NOTHING IS THE SAME SHAPE WITH THE TENTH NO DOWN A COAST ROAD AND NOT IN A ROOM, AND IT IS RULED AS DELIVERED.** The one no with a reason about a line of writing and not about a person: one, being the woman of no office's, on the face of `chapter-0351.md:49` and `chapter-0351.md:59`. The one who said nothing: one, being a boat's man of about forty-one of the second lay, entered as what it was and not counted as either. The name and an hour against every line: thirteen lines, a name and an hour on all thirteen and a price and a payer on eleven, and the price on all eleven is the word *nothing*. The yard charged nobody for the writing, and it wrote to none of the five towns that hold the copies, and it did not ask who put the page up on the wall in the town four days up that coast. **RULED PAID.**
2. **THE STARTING STATE, ALL TEN ITEMS, AS THE LAST PAGE OF VOLUME 07 LEFT IT. AUDITED ITEM BY ITEM AGAINST CHAPTER 351 AND AGAINST CHAPTER 400, AND THE HOUSE'S OWN POORER-ON-THE-LAST-PAGE TEST IS BINDING.** (1) A bag with nothing in it, being no pence, and the figure short of the wage being six hundred and forty: **STILL STANDING, and five hundred and sixty-four at the open and four hundred and eighty at the close, never zero.** (2) A harbor poorer than on the fourteenth of May: **STILL STANDING AND WORSE, and none of its ten items improved.** (3) A notice of eight clauses on a market wall since the seventeenth of May, untouched, not withdrawn, with two older naval notices: **STILL STANDING AT NINETY-EIGHT DAYS, NOT TOUCHED, AND THE SIXTH CLAUSE'S DOOR WAS USED FOUR TIMES IN THE FIFTY DAYS AND ASKED NOBODY ANYTHING ON ANY OF THEM.** (4) A page of forty lines on a market wall in a town four days up that coast, with a name and an hour on all forty and the wrong figure standing beside its own correction: **STILL STANDING, AND THE COAL LOCKER CAME DOWN A COAST ROAD TWICE IN THIS VOLUME.** (5) The Storm-Reader stage taken once, the mark's new use closed at four figures with no fifth, the second seam's season and the mark four hundred yards off it nine marks each, neither paid: **ALL THREE STILL STANDING, THE USE STILL CLOSED AT FOUR FIGURES WITH NO FIFTH, AND NEITHER NINE-MARK FIGURE PAID.** (6) A wreck of about nineteen tons on the foul, six owners ashore with no boat, no instrument and no proposal, and a man of about fifty-one who has said he will write the six of them on a page and put it on that mole: **STILL STANDING, THE SIX STILL ASHORE, THE MAN STILL ON THE CROWN WITH HIS PAGE AND HIS STONE AND NO FIGURE AGAINST HIM AND FORTY DAYS OF SILENCE AND NOTHING GIVEN TO HIM BY ANYBODY.** (7) A custody room with three items under three numbers, none returned and none asked for, a municipal claim on the third: **STILL STANDING, THE ROOM NOT ENTERED, NO DIGIT ON ANY PAGE, THE CLAIM NOT WITHDRAWN, NO REQUEST MADE, AND A PAPER ON ITS DOOR GIVING TWO PEOPLE A SUPERVISED LOOK AT ONE OF THE THREE.** (8) The three figures that must not be swapped: **STILL STANDING AND IN THAT ORDER ON EVERY PAGE THAT CARRIES THEM, BEING NINE COMMUNITIES AND THE RECORDS ONE IN EACH, SIX CENTURIES OF THAT PRACTICE, THREE HUNDRED YEARS OF THE OFFICE THAT ANSWERS IT, AND THE OFFICE'S THREE HUNDRED YEARS WAS NOT HANDED TO THE COMMUNITIES.** (9) About eleven people who cannot read the notice, and a man of thirty-two days down that coast, and nobody sent and nothing written: **STILL STANDING, THE COUNT ARRIVED AT BY TWO PEOPLE COUNTING SEPARATELY AND ADDING, AND IT IS NOT ABOUT ELEVEN MEN IN ANY ONE BOAT, AND NOBODY WAS SENT.** (10) A day lost on Thursday the first of July to a thing that has no name in it, with a reason and no name and no figure, and no day of any week before that one entered against the same line afterwards: **STILL STANDING AND NAMED NOWHERE AND NOT PAID AND NOT NAMED.**
   **THE RULING: ALL TEN ARE STILL STANDING AT THE LAST PAGE OF THIS VOLUME AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS IMPROVED, AND THE HARBOUR IS POORER ON THE FIFTIETH CHAPTER THAN ON THE FIRST. A CLOSE THAT FOUND THE HARBOUR IMPROVED ON ANY ITEM WOULD BE WRONG, AND THIS ONE DOES NOT FIND IT IMPROVED ON ANY.**
3. **THE STARTING RELATIONSHIPS, ALL EIGHT, INCLUDING THE ONE THAT MAY NOT BE APPROACHED. RULED PAID IN ALL EIGHT, AND LOCK L18 RULED SPECIFICALLY.** Calder and Mara: the apology is owed at the open, is not said in Movement 1, is paid once in Movement 2 on the water on the twenty-first of July, is not forgiven and not thanked, and she asks for a procedure instead; she is in that harbor and goes nowhere, of no office, not on the crew, not restored, not forgiven, forty marks first after food neither reduced nor paid at the last page; five of the eleven leaves are her own hand and the instrument asks for them and her own book of hand is not among the eleven and was not asked for and is not on the instrument. Calder and Nessa: the pair the record stands on, and she is the only person in the yard who is asked to say what a thing costs before anybody agrees to it, and she prices in hours and material, and on the last page of the volume it is her hand that reads the leaf back in full with both definitions on the face of the reading. Calder and Alden: **RULED HELD, at § 5 above, on all three clauses, with a count of three and all three being the disambiguation.** Calder and Bevin: off the stone since the fifteenth of May, forty marks whole, the three nots of the eighth standing unasked and unasked for a sixth week at the last page, the third column empty and unappointed, his hand at the head of it with a name beside it that is not said out loud again and his surname on no page of the fifty. Calder and Tobias Wren: **RULED HELD, at § 5 above, on every clause of lock L27a.** Calder and the wardrobe: every man and woman the outline's lock L28 names is on a page, and none of them is a witness, a symbol, an officer, a member of anything, a courier or a face. And the eighth, which is the volume's own: **THE CONDITION AND THE FIFTH THING, WHICH IS A PERSON AND IS NOT ON A LIST, PAID AS A BEGINNING IN MOVEMENT 4 AND NOT AS A STAGE, WITH FOUR THINGS ON A LEAF AND A CAULKER OF ABOUT TWENTY-THREE WHO IS ON A DAY AND A WAGE AND AN HOUR AND ON NOTHING ELSE AND WHO TOLD THAT YARD HE WOULD NOT BE ON THE STONE ON THE SUNDAY.**

THE STORM-READER STAGE WAS NOT TAKEN AGAIN AND WAS NOT IMPROVED. THE WORD *KEELWRIGHT* IS IN NO MOUTH ON ANY PAGE AND THE COUNT IS ZERO. THE CONDITION IS NAMED NOWHERE AND PAYING ITS COST IS NOT NAMING IT.** What the volume paid instead of a stage: a condition said once in the holder's own mouth, a wage and a day and a person who is there on a Tuesday, a sheet with about thirty men's names on it carried into company, eleven dates read aloud in a public room, a squadron's work stopped on a reach with his own mouth, an admission said once on a mole, and a man with a form in his hand walked away from unasked.
5. **THE FOUR MAJOR LOCATIONS AND THE THREE FORUMS KEPT DISTINCT. RULED PAID ON ALL FOUR LOCATIONS AND RULED ON THE FORUMS WITH THREE COUNTS.** The outer water off Morrow Quay and the moorings at Ternwatch: paid in Movement 1, where a tender of about ninety tons lay for six days and a young man of about twenty-three stood in his own wheelhouse with a telescope and hailed nobody. Veyr's diplomatic quarter: paid in Movement 2, in a room off a street behind the fish market with a clerk in it and no title in it. Border reefs and a convoy of confiscated memory vessels: paid in Movement 3. The harbor line, the market wall, the shed and the mole: paid in every movement, fifty days out of fifty. **AND THE THREE FORUMS, COUNTED: *THE HARBOR AUTHORITY'S HEARING ROOM* IS NAMED ON NO PAGE OF THE FIFTY CHAPTERS AND THE COUNT IS ZERO, AND WHAT STANDS IN ITS PLACE IS THE OFFICE OF THE MORROW QUAY HARBOR AUTHORITY ON THE WEST BASIN, WHICH IS THE REEVE'S OFFICE, AND IT LISTS, IT ENTERS, IT PAYS A DAY WITH A BOAT AND TWO MEN OUT OF A BERTH FUND AT THE FIGURE IN CHALK, IT KEEPS A REGISTER COPY OF WHAT IT IS GIVEN, AND ITS LIST IS NOT A SCHEDULE AND BINDS NOBODY, AND IT DECIDES NO CONTESTED CLAIM IN THIS VOLUME. *THE MORROW CIRCUIT OFFICE* DECIDES PROVENANCE AND CUSTODY AND IS NAMED IN FIVE CHAPTERS, BEING 351, 356, 357, 399 AND 400, AND IT HOLDS THREE THINGS, A CLAIM IN A BOOK SINCE THE DECEMBER BEFORE LAST, A COPYING CLERK, AND A PAPER ON A DOOR. *THE COURT OF WRECK CLAIMS* IS ON NO PAGE OF THE FIFTY CHAPTERS AND THE COUNT OF THE PHRASE IS ZERO, AND AN INSTITUTION THAT IS ON NO PAGE CANNOT SPEAK. RULED: THE THREE ARE KEPT DISTINCT AND THE CHAPTERS' NAME FOR THE FIRST IS NOT THE ONE THE AUDIT WAS GIVEN, AND THAT IS RECORDED AS DELIVERED AND NOT REPAIRED.**
6. **THE MAJOR FACTIONS, AS A SYSTEM AND NOT AS VILLAINS. RULED PAID ON ALL SEVEN AND NONE IS A VILLAIN.** The Serein Crown: a political system, appearing as an instrument with four prices, a standing instruction dated before the blockade and countersigned, a patrol, a printed nine-line claim, an inquiry that is an institution and does not speak, and a seal line. The Lantern Registry: paperwork, appearing as a seal and a countersignature and a word on the head of a form. The Crown Navy with internal disagreement in it: a squadron of about nine boats with a working man of nineteen at a tiller and a face of about thirty-one with a board under his arm, and a ship of about sixty tons that has gone up-coast. The Morrow Quay harbor authority: a reeve's office on a west basin with a clerk of about sixty, twenty-two years, owed a quarter, no book and no power, and a man of about fifty with two papers and two boxes. About ten independent masters and about thirty men: **ABOUT ELEVEN MASTERS WERE ASKED ONE AT A TIME IN THE SAME WORDS ACROSS TEN DAYS, SEVEN SAID YES AND FOUR SAID NO, EVERY REFUSAL WITH A REASON GIVEN AND NOT ASKED FOR TWICE, NO NAME AGAINST ANY OF THE FOUR AND NO FIGURE AGAINST ANY OF THE SEVEN, AND THE COST OF THE FOUR IS A MAN'S DAY AND NOT A FIGURE AGAINST HIM, AND SEVEN BOATS WENT OUT AND CAME BACK AND SEVEN BOATS ARE SEVEN BOATS AND A FOOT AND NOT A FLEET AND NOT A COMPANY AND NOT A CREW AND NOT THE BEGINNING OF ONE.** And about eleven people in one harbour who cannot read the notice: **A COUNT OF PEOPLE AND NOT A FIGURE, ARRIVED AT BY TWO PEOPLE COUNTING SEPARATELY AND ADDING, NOT A CONSTITUENCY, NOT NAMED, NOT SENT FOR, AND NOBODY IN THAT HARBOR HAS TOLD ANY OF THEM ANYTHING AND NOTHING WAS WRITTEN.**
7. **THE FIVE MOVEMENTS, EACH PAID, IN ORDER, AND THE OUTLINE'S OWN WORDS FOR EACH. RULED PAID IN ALL FIVE, COUNTED AT § 7 ABOVE, AND THE FIVE ARE PAID IN THE ORDER THE OUTLINE NAMES THEM, WITH MOVEMENT 5 PAID IN THE OUTLINE'S OWN FOUR-PART ORDER: THE CONVOY, THE PATROL, HIM STOPPING THE NAVAL ACTION RATHER THAN CHASING THE EVIDENCE, AND THE ADMISSION.**
8. **THE VOLUME'S CLIMAX AND ITS FOUR ELEMENTS ON THE PAGE, AND THE ORDER OF THE REVEAL RULED SEPARATELY. RULED PAID IN ALL FOUR, IN THE OUTLINE'S ORDER, WITH COUNTS AT § 7 ITEM 5 ABOVE. AND THE ORDER OF THE REVEAL IS RULED: THE ELEVEN WEEKS WERE READ OUT ALOUD IN A PUBLIC ROOM OVER THE FISH MARKET ON THE TWENTY-SECOND OF AUGUST IN THE ORDER THEY WERE SIGNED, BEING THE EIGHTH, FIFTEENTH, TWENTY-SECOND AND TWENTY-NINTH OF MAY, THE FIFTH, TWELFTH, NINETEENTH AND TWENTY-SIXTH OF JUNE, AND THE THIRD, TENTH AND TWENTY-SECOND OF JULY, TEN OF THEM A WEEK APART AND THE LAST TWELVE DAYS AFTER THE ONE BEFORE IT, AND NO DATE WAS MOVED TO MAKE IT COME OUT EVEN; AND THE COUNTERSIGNED FORM'S SHAPE WAS READ OUT **AFTER** THEM AND NOT BEFORE THEM, AND THE REASON WAS GIVEN OUT LOUD, BEING THAT HE HAS NOT GOT THE THING AND THAT IF THE WORD HAD BEEN READ FIRST THE WORD WOULD BE WHAT HAPPENED IN A MONTH AND IN A YEAR AND THE ELEVEN HULLS WOULD BE WHAT WAS SAID ABOUT IT. **THAT ORDER IS FIXED AND WAS NOT INVERTED ON ANY PAGE OF THE FIFTY, AND WHAT WAS READ ALOUD WAS THE SHAPE OF THE FORM AND NOT THE FORM, THE WORD *UNSEALED* AT THE HEAD OF IT, TWO RULED COLUMNS, THE SAME ELEVEN MARKS AGAINST THE SAME ELEVEN DATES, TWO IMPRESSIONS STRUCK SIDE BY SIDE AT THE FOOT OF WHICH HE READ NEITHER, AND THE FOURTEENTH OF FEBRUARY CUT INTO THE TIMBER ABOVE THE HEAD. HE DOES NOT HAVE THE FORM, HE HAS NO COPY OF IT, AND NO DOCUMENT OF ANYBODY'S CHANGES HANDS IN THAT HARBOUR ON ANY OF THE FIFTY DAYS.**
9. **THE FOUR ITEMS OF THE CONCRETE RESOLUTION, NONE OF THEM SOFT, AND THE THIRD ONE THE CROWN'S WIN. RULED PAID IN ALL FOUR.** (1) **SOREN VEY LOSES HIS FLAGSHIP AND HIS COMMAND, AND HE IS NOT IN A ROOM WHEN IT HAPPENS AND DOES NOT APPEAR AGAIN ON THE PAGE IN PERSON:** a ship of about sixty tons with the squadron's own boats in company went up that coast in the night of the twenty-first and the small boat of about twelve tons went in front of her, and neither has been on that reach since; his name is on the face of one instrument in Movement 1 and in no mouth, in no room, on no mole and in no market in the remaining forty-nine chapters, and the count of his name across the fifty chapters is three, all three being that instrument's face or the yard's own report of it. (2) **THE CROWN TURNS THE DEFEAT INTO A CLAIM THAT INDEPENDENT SALVAGERS ARE DANGEROUS, AND THE CLAIM IS PRINTED, AND IT IS THE BEST PAPER THE CROWN PRODUCES IN THIS VOLUME:** the nine-line sheet with a seal on it went up in the front street of that harbor on the fourteenth of August, which is a Saturday, on the outside of a figure that was not taken down first; it proposes that every concern which takes work out of a hull and keeps no account of what it has taken be entered in one register, and that a concern not entered in that register is a concern whose accounts are not to be produced to anybody; it names no person and no harbor, puts no figure on it, has no price at the end of it and asks nothing of anybody standing in that street; it is true enough on the face of it that nobody who reads it can go up the street and say it is a lie; **it is read twice and answered by nobody, by nobody in that harbor and by nobody in these fifty chapters and by no office in any city, and it is not answered by any character and no character calls it a lie.** (3) **THE INQUIRY'S TERMS GIVE CALDER AND MARA SUPERVISED AND LIMITED ACCESS TO THE SEIZED GANNET SHARD IN THE MORROW CIRCUIT CUSTODY ROOM, AND IT IS THE CROWN'S WIN:** the instrument is a paper pinned at the corner of a shut door in a corridor of the circuit office on that hill, on that door a day or two, not taken down by anybody in that building, naming Calder Marr and Mara Venn as permitted at the hour named and Saul Drury, copying clerk of that office, as present in it for the whole of it, and saying in three further lines that it is a look at one thing out of three and not a taking, that nothing is to go out of that room in any hand, and that the hour named is the end of it and not the middle of it; the figure on it is ten in the morning on Tuesday the twenty-fourth day of August at that door, **and it is the only figure in the fifty chapters of that yard that is not a price anybody paid**; **the room is not entered, no digit of any of its three numbers is on any page, the third of the three is not on the paper, the municipal claim on the third is not withdrawn, and no request for it has been made by anybody.** (4) **A NEW SEAL LINE AT THE LAST PAGE NAMES A NEW OFFICE, IN NO MOUTH, WITH NO MINISTER IN A ROOM AND NOBODY IN A ROOM:** *Sealed and entered at the Morrow circuit office by order of Magister Ilya Serr, Registrar of Recovered Accounts*, and the office at the end of it is not one that has ever sent that yard anything, and the seal line is not the shape of any other seal line that yard has seen; **it is on one page of one chapter, it is read out once by nobody in that building and by nobody in that harbor, and it is used again nowhere in the volume.**
10. **THE NEW-VOLUME QUESTION, ASKED ONCE AND ANSWERED NOWHERE. RULED PAID AND RULED UNANSWERED.** *If the Navy cannot own the sea by force, is the Crown going to try to own history by making it legally singular?* **THE COUNT OF THE QUESTION ACROSS THE FIFTY CHAPTERS IS ONE, and it is asked out loud by a man with no office, in the office on the west basin, at about ten to six on Sunday the twenty-second, in a room with a clerk of about sixty in it, twenty-two years in that room, owed a quarter, with no book and no power; it names no person. NO CHARACTER ANSWERS IT, NOBODY PROPOSES ANYTHING IN ANSWER TO IT, NOBODY NAMES A CENTRAL BODY, A COMMITTEE, AN ASSEMBLY, A FLEET, A WING OR A GUARD, AND THE COUNT OF THE SIX CATEGORIES PRINTED AS AN ENUMERATION ANYWHERE IN THE FIFTY CHAPTERS IS ZERO AFTER THE REPAIRS AT § 12 ITEMS 7, 9 AND 10. **AND THE OTHERS, EACH ON A PAGE AND ON A DAY, NONE OF THEM A WITNESS:** Peat Marrow, of about fifty-three, with a bad back and a winch on the third lay; Nessa Pike, the ship's hand, who prices before anybody agrees and reads the leaf back with both definitions on the face of the reading; Mara Venn, of no office, of forty marks first after food neither reduced nor paid; Isaac Fell, a caulker of about twenty-three, on a day and a wage and an hour and on nothing else; a copyist of about fifty-nine with twenty-two years in a room off that market; a clerk of about sixty with twenty-two years in the office on the west basin, owed a quarter of a pound, with no book and no power; a man of about fifty with two papers on one table; a man of about fifty-one on the crown of that mole; a man of about thirty-eight with a boat of about thirteen tons and no papers on her; a man of about thirty-one of the third lay with a chart in a bag; a woman of about fifty-eight with an end stall and a slate; a cooper of about forty-four with a shop on the far street; and a herring skipper of fifty-one with a boat called the *Anna Ray* of about fifty tons and nineteen winters against him who said no to a mark and eightpence in his own market and is not asked for anything.

### 7. The cost, and the bodies, at the last page of the ten

**THE COST OF MOVEMENT 1 IS PAID IN FIVE THINGS AND IN NOTHING ELSE. AN HOUR, at ten in the morning on Tuesday the twenty-fourth, which is the end of that hour and not the middle of it. NINE DAYS OF A REFUSAL ON A DOOR, from Wednesday the twenty-fifth to Thursday the second of September, with the reason written in a clerk's own hand and the reason being a figure, and the figure being seven. A FRAGMENT WITH A SEAM IN IT, LOOKED AT FOR THE BETTER PART OF AN HOUR BY THREE PEOPLE, TWO OF WHOM CAME OUT OF IT CARRYING A HALF OF SOMETHING THEY CANNOT MATCH TO EACH OTHER AND HAVE AGREED IN THEIR OWN MOUTHS NEVER TO MATCH. FIVE AFTERNOONS OF A MAN WITH A BAD BACK AT A WALL IN A ROOM HE DOES NOT WORK IN, AT NO FIGURE, UNPAID AND UNTHANKED. AND A HARBOR THAT IS POORER ON THE SECOND DAY OF SEPTEMBER THAN IT WAS ON THE TWENTY-THIRD OF AUGUST.**

**NO MAN DIED, NO BODY IS NAMED, NO CASUALTY FIGURE IS PRINTED ON ANY PAGE, AND THE COUNT OF THE WORD *THOUSAND* IN A MOUTH IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS IS ZERO. NOTHING IN THE HARBOR IS BETTER AT THE LAST PAGE THAN AT THE FIRST.**

**AND THE STANDING LIST, ALL UNPAID AND ALL UNMOVED, AND NONE OF IT ENTERED IN FULL IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS, BECAUSE THE STANDING INVENTORY IS ENTERED IN FULL ONCE IN THIS VOLUME AND ONCE ONLY AND IT IS NOT THIS BATCH'S TO PRINT:** three marks to a man of Ashtide, whose anchor date of the eighth of August past is a legacy of an earlier entry and is ruled not repaired and may not be re-dated, advanced, reduced or paid; seven pence to that yard's own shipwright; eight marks and a day of a boat to that harbor's own bellwright, unargued, chest shut, not asked in one hundred and ten days; eight shillings and tenpence to a woman with her name on the figure; forty marks first after food to a person of no office; forty marks whole to a boy of twenty-two. And standing with those six: a page of six names on a mole with a boat as a price and no figure; a municipal claim on one of the three things in the circuit custody room; a box in an office on the west basin that is no longer empty and another box on the other paper that is and that a man of about fifty wants left empty; a nine-line sheet with a seal on it in the front street, answered by nobody; and a slip of paper with a figure on it and no name on it in a drawer, not looked at, not priced, not headed.

### 8. What was done, in one paragraph, and what this batch may not be used for

**WHAT MOVEMENT 1 DID, IN ONE PARAGRAPH: A PARTY OF THREE WENT INTO A CUSTODY ROOM BEHIND A DOOR FOR ONE HOUR AND CAME OUT AND THE HOUR WAS THE END OF IT AND NOT THE MIDDLE OF IT; A CUT EDGE AND A SEAM WERE READ UNDER A WHITE LIGHT AND THE SEAM WAS NOT ALLOWED TO NAME ANYBODY; AN OFFICE SAID NO ON A DOOR IN A CLERK'S OWN HAND FOR NINE DAYS AND THEN SAID YES AND WROTE DOWN WHAT A COPY OF THAT THING COSTS AT THAT BENCH, IN A FIGURE, WITH HIS OWN NAME UNDER IT; A MAN WITH A BAD BACK COUNTED A MUNICIPAL RETURN LINE BY LINE WITH A PENCIL AT A WALL ON FIVE AFTERNOONS OF HIS OWN TIME AND SAID THE FIGURE OUT LOUD ONCE, ON A DAY HE HAD NAMED, AND WAS NOT PAID AND WAS NOT THANKED; THE FIGURE WENT INTO THE FIRST COLUMN OF THAT YARD'S OWN LEAF WITH ITS SUMMANDS AND ITS LINE COUNT UNDER IT AND WITH NO NAME AGAINST IT; A CAULKER WAS ASKED FOR TWO DAYS BY NAME AND PAID IN COIN ON A STONE AT AN HOUR; AND THE FOURTH COLUMN TOOK NO LINE FOR TEN DAYS AND THE REASON WAS ENTERED ONCE IN THE SECOND COLUMN IN THE YARD'S OWN MOUTH.**

**WHAT THIS BATCH MAY NOT BE USED FOR: it may not be used to say that anything was made, because nothing was made and the paper on the door says so in a figure; it may not be used to say that the two halves of the aftertaste have been matched, because they have not and two people have agreed in their own mouths never to match them; it may not be used to say that the third of the three things in that room has been looked at, named or asked for; it may not be used to say that the municipal claim on the third has been withdrawn; it may not be used to enter a hundred and twenty-sixth line in the fourth column, which nobody is to enter in this volume; it may not be used to date the second entry into that room, which is the fifth of October and is the climax's; and it may not be used to say that a man with a bad back has been paid or thanked for five afternoons at a wall, because he has been neither.**

1. **FINDING 1, THE MOST SERIOUS, AND IT WAS A REAL ONE: CHAPTER 407 SPOILED AND CONTRADICTED CHAPTER 409'S CENTRAL REVEAL.** Chapter 407, on the Monday the thirtieth of August, had Calder Marr sum all five blocks of the return and reach three hundred and ninety-one on the flat of the bench stone at half past five, two days before Peat Marrow says the figure out loud in a front street in Chapter 409. It also claimed in the same paragraph that he had verified the five summands against what Marrow had said out loud to him in the front street on the Thursday, when on the Thursday Marrow had said only the line count for April and had said he would do May on Friday.
